Cases reported from Block Mahesana, Mehesana City (Lalchand Lati) due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Total 137 Residual Chlorine test done in which 103 found positive, 34 found negative. Active surveillance, chlorination and pipeline leakages repair activity done in affected area. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people.

Cases reported from Village Mota Mandala, Khabji, Garda, PHC/ SC Mandala, Block Depiyapada. Cases found during house to house surveillance. Immunization and Vitamin - A solution activity done as per age group. Health education imparted among the affected village people.

Cases reported from Siddhpur, Chandravati, Kholwada (Madhupura) due to consumption of contaminated food, Gorsai (made of milk). Medical Officer Chandravati and BHO Siddhpur visited village along with paramedical staff. All control measures were taken. The children have taken treatment at G.H.Siddhpur.

Outbreak reported from Village Vadi, Dera, Talav & Panchayat Falia, PHC / SC Vadi, Block Mangrot. Epidemic response team and RCHO visited affected village. Out of 35 patients 33 have been immunized with measles vaccine. Vaccination status of one is unknown and other one is due for immunization in next week. Active surveillance is going on. Vitamin –A given to the affected persons and IEC activities undertaken.

Outbreak reported from Village Dharampuri, PHC Bhilodiya, SC Vadhana, Block Dabhoi due to consumption of contaminated food in village marriage function. CDHO, EMO and his team visited and investigated the affected area. Food samples not collected because food are not available at that time, Water samples taken and send for bacteriological analysis at PHL, Baroda Medical College, Vadodara. Symptomatic treatment given at CHC Dabhoi and at village. Active surveillance for detection of new cases done.

Outbreak reported from Rajnagar Baharjola Village at Rajnagar Baharjola Sub Center, Anantapur-II, GP under Anantapur BPH. People are affected with fever with rash. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Samples taken and lab result is positive for Measles. Distributed vitamin –A oil, Cotriomoxazole tablets and ORS packet among the affected village people. Health education imparted among the affected village people.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from East Kameng due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation. 10 new cases reported in this week.

Cases with fever and rash reported from East Kameng, Seppa Town. District RRT visited the affected area. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases. 5 new cases reported in this week.

Outbreak reported from Village Khadsupa, PHC Adada, Block Navsari. All cases are children of one school, presenting with symptoms of pain abdomen, vomiting and diarrhoea, after consumption of contaminated food. Water and food samples sent to Microbiology Department, Surat for lab test; result awaited. House to house surveillance done to find new cases. Severely ill cases referred to CHC Khadsupa for treatment. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Hirapur, PHC Torna, Sub Center Torna-1, and Block Kapadwanj. Medical Officer visited and investigated the affected area. Vitamin – A solution given to the affected village people. Health education imparted among the affected village people.

Outbreak reported from Village/ PHC Nandigudi, Taluka Harihara due to consumption of contaminated stale food of previous day by school children of Morarji Desai Residential School. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. 3 Water samples collected, but food samples could not be collected. Health education given to affected village persons. Staff in the Residential School informed to maintain kitchen hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Netapur under Gop CHC Puri. There is no tube well and well in this village. Only supply water is the source of drinking water which is insufficient. So most of the people use contaminated river water for drinking purpose. District RRT & Block RRT investigated and given treatment and health education to the people of affected village. Instruction has been given to the concerned health institution for collection of samples. The paramedical staff camped at affected village for case management and active surveillance. Minor ailment, ORS, Halazone tablets has been given. Health education like personal hygiene & use of boiled drinking water etc. are being undertaken by the staff of the concerned health facility. At present number of cases are in decreasing trend.

Cases of acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) reported from Khagaria. Serum samples sent for lab investigation for polio; result awaited. Medical officer visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak of fever with myalgia, clinically diagnosed as Scrub Typhus reported from Village/Subcenter Majharnu, Block Padhar, CH. Jogindernagar. All cases responded to antibiotics (Doxycycline). Medical team sent to the affected area to treat cases and to do active surveillance for new fever cases with eschar. Sera sample sent for lab investigation; result awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Sanawad, Shahpura, Block Barwaha, Gagawan, Kasrawad. All cases are in the age group of 11 months to 10 years. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children. Serum samples collected and sent for lab confirmation; result awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting occurred in Villages Kupire (12 cases), and Mahe (16 cases) under Block Karveer after consumption of contaminated stale food. District RRT visited the affected area, treated cases and investigated the outbreak. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Mangoli under Block Radhanagari due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases of fever and jaundice reported from Village / Block Chandgad due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in water supply pipeline. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Cases treated symptomatically. Contaminated water supply was stopped and the defective valve was repaired. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak of vomiting with fever occurred among people from village Sarekhi Ka Pura under PHC Pachgaun, Block Dholpur due to consumption of contaminated and stale food (aloo-tikki). District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Severely ill cases were referred to the District Hospital and GH Dholpur. PHC medical team set up temporary camp at the affected village to treat cases and conducted active survey for new cases. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Thingling under Yoksum PHC. Medical officer with team visited the affected area and treated all cases symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

All cases are clinically diagnosed as chickenpox children from Village Kamanpatty, Block/PHC Athoor. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Sevvaipettai, PHC Anandur Block R.S.Mangalam due to consumption of contaminated food. Food samples sent to Madurai Medical College, Madurai for lab analysis; result awaited. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from Villages Pallakal and Pothukudi under PHC Mukkudal, Block Ambai. Out of 16 stool samples sent to Microbiology lab, 6 samples tested positive for V. cholerae. House to house surveillance done for new cases. Cases treated with antibiotics & fluids. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets provided to every household. Overhead tanks cleaned and chlorinated. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases with symptoms of fever, weight loss, diarrhoea and splenomegaly reported from villages Barapalasan, Khati Para, Subcenter Arapalasan, Block Memari II. District RRT visited the affected area. Out of 11 blood samples collected and tested by rk39 test, 7 samples found positive for Kala-azar. All cases treated. IEC conducted regarding personal protection measures.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from Village Krishnapur, SC Saraitikar, Rajbati, Block Sadar I. District RRT visited the affected area. Water samples collected from water sources for lab analysis; results awaited. Symptomatic treatment given. IEC conducted regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever reported with joint pain from Villages Darjipara Margram, Rampurhat-II Block. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Out of 15 sera samples of fever cases sent to School of Tropical Medicine, Kolkata for serological testing for Dengue, Chikungunya and Japanese Encephalitis, 1 tested positive for Dengue and one for JE. House to house surveillance done to find new fever cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Java Dinajpurpara, GP Yandarkhola, Krishnagar-I Block, Sadar SD due to consumption of contaminated food on 14.03.11 morning (leftover food of a marriage party held on 13.03.11). District RRT visited the affected area, treated cases and investigated the outbreak. Severely ill cases admitted at District Hospital. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from Seppa Town, East Kameng due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Dumaria, Naya Tola, Block Raniganj, Ward No. 5,6,8. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Rukadi (114 cases), Nave Pragaon (260 cases), and Block Hatangale due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in water supply pipeline. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Contaminated water supply was stopped and the defective valve was repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of jaundice and fever reported from villages Bolipara, Vijarbari, Fautiapara under PHC Bahadur Block Sadar, Maynaguri. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. All cases are children below 10 yrs of age. 4 sera samples sent to STM, Kolkata for serological test; result awaited. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever and typical maculopapulovescicular rash reported from GP/PHC Barnis under Block Maynaguri (115 cases); and from Village Sakirjote, GP Majhiali, PHC Kalinagar (22 cases) and from village Soloidanga, GP Mantadari, subcenter Moringajhora (26 cases) under Block Rajganj. District RRT visited the affected area and treated all cases symptomatically. Cases are in the age-group of 8-23 years. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Outbreak reported from village Bhotpatty, GP Padamati-I, PHC Bhurangerbari under Block Maynaguri (11 cases); and from SC Silbarihat, GP Patlakhawa (30 cases) and SC Pradhanpara and Natunpara, GP Salkumar-I (15 cases) under Block Alipurduar-I. Measles vaccination given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Daravarithota, Ongole Mandal. Cases treated symptomatically. Sera samples not collected for lab test. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases reported from Nidamarru Village, Mandal/PHC, P.N.Kolanu due to consumption of contaminated water. Water samples collected and sent to public health lab; result awaited. Chlorination of water sources done. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Barazara, Chupa-Seal Chupa under Chamata BPHC due to consumption of contaminated food at a common gathering. All cases are admitted at S.M.K Civil Hospital, Nalbari and are in the age-group of 15-35 years. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Piplod, Dadgarvaas De Baria Road, PHC Guna, Block De Baria due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Water samples taken from the affected area and sent for lab test. Leakages in water supply pipeline detected and repaired. All cases are now recovering. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Jun Ugala, PHC Dhokadwa, Block Una due to consumption of contaminated water. Water samples sent for lab testing; result awaited. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Block, njar, CHC Rambang Hospital, City Gandhidham. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

All cases are children with typical rash and fever, from Village/SC Varatha, PHC Dabhoda, Block Kheralu. Nine cases admitted at a private hospital (Jatan Hospital) at Kheralu. Symptomatic treatment given to all cases. District RRT visited the affected area. Sera samples not collected for lab test. Health education given to community for isolation of cases.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Village Bhensia, PHC Mendhar, Block Gandevi due to consumption of contaminated food. House to house surveillance done to find new cases. Cases managed at hospital. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Chlorination of water sources done. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Nathkuva, SC Virapura, PHC Ranjitnagar, Block Ghoghamba. District RRT visited the affected area. Sera samples sent for lab confirmation; result awaited. Health education given regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Cases reported from Village Ghodana Muvada, SC Agarwada, PHC Vardhari, Block Lunawada. District RRT visited the affected area to treat cases and investigate the outbreak. Sera samples sent for lab confirmation; result awaited. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village/SC Mota, PHC Umarakh, Block Bardoli, due to leakage in water supply pipeline. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Water samples sent for lab testing; result awaited. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Nadakalmole, PHC Kempayanpalya, Taluka Sante Marahali. Isolation and symptomatic treatment of cases done. Health education given regarding hygienic practices, nutrition and preventive measures.

Cases reported from Village Haladge, PHC Mayadiyal, Taluka Alanda due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in water pipeline. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Water samples on lab test found not potable One stool sample tested positive for V.cholerae (Ogawa). Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated with antibiotics. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak with fever and typical rash reported from Murarji Desai, Hostel, under Taluka Belur. District RRT visited the affected area. Being a rented building, the hostel was not well maintained wrt cleanliness and sanitation. Isolation and symptomatic treatment of cases done. Health education given regarding hygienic practices, nutrition and preventive measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Thamatampalli, PHC Addagal, Taluka Srinivasapur due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in drinking water pipeline at four sites. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool samples tested negative for cholera. Water samples on analysis found contaminated. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and proper food handling. Gram Panchayat advised to provide alternate safe drinking water till repair of water pipelines.

Outbreak reported from Village Upparadoddi, PHC Gurudevaranahalli, Taluka Maddur due to consumption of contaminated food in village festival. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Food samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Stool samples tested negative for cholera. House to house survey done. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and food sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Vontikopal, Taluka Mysore, among school children who consumed a common type of chocolates. Cases presented with symptoms of pain abdomen and vomiting. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Kammaguttahalli, Taluka Chikkaballapura. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. 5 sera samples sent to NIV for lab confirmation; result awaited. Health education given regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Navodaya School, Asamara Road probably due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. All cases treated. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases with fever and typical rash reported from Village Handiganadagu (Kushalapura) PHC Kandikere, Taluka C N Hali. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Symptomatic treatment given. Health education given.

Outbreak of fever with typical rash clinically diagnosed as chicken pox reported from Village Komaralahalli, Yerrapalya Singareddy, PHC Kotegudda, Taluka Pavagada. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases reported from Village Mantya, PHC Amrathur, Taluka Kunigal due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited the affected area, investigated the outbreak and treated cases. Stool samples on culture test found positive for Escherichia coli. All water samples found potable. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever, bodyache and typical rash reported from Village/PHC Kumaramangalam, Block Purapuzha. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Health education given regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases with abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea reported from Village Karuvanpadi, PHC Pallipuram, Block Koppam due to consumption of contaminated food (soft drinks?). District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Medical camp was conducted in the area. Door to door survey for new cases done in the area. All cases treated. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Children in the age-group of 3 - 9 years presented with fever and rash from Village Rampur, Bishnupur, Subcenter Ganjrampur, CHC Noorbad, Block Morena. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. All cases are vaccinated for measles. Health education given regarding providing proper nutrition, isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Sub Center Mundsar, CHC Napasar, Block Bikaner due to consumption of contaminated food. Block medical team visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Door to door survey conducted. Health education given about food poisoning/intoxication and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village/GP Dhabalpur under Block Seragada due to consumption of contaminated water of pond. Block health team visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. 13 cases admitted in the PHC Seragada and all the patients were treated with IV fluid and antibiotics. ORS packet and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given to the community on personal hygienic measures.

Cases of diarrhoea with fever reported from Salaguda UP School, GP / SC Palmendi, Block Chakapad, CHC Brahomanpad. District RRT and ADMO (PH) with medical team visited the affected school and village, and conducted house to house survey to find new cases. Blood samples collected for lab test; result awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Girliguda, GP Kapatiti, Subcenter Gunthawada, CHC/Block Korukonda, due to consumption of contaminated water from an open well, as the tube-well was non-functional. Medical officer of Chitrakonda with team visited the affected area. Chlorination of drinking water source done and Halozone tablets distributed to the villagers. Executive Engineer RWSS informed and requested to repair of defunct tube well. Health workers and ASHA deployed in the village help in treating cases and to report daily cases. IEC/BCC activities done in the village regarding sanitation and cleanliness.

Outbreak reported from Village Terundia, Ojha sahi and Paltasahi under Charichhak CHC, Block Nimapara due to consumption of contaminated food at a marriage ceremony. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in affected area. Medical team of CHC Charichhak set up camp at affected village to treat cases and distributed Halogens tablets, ORS packets and anti- diarrhoea medicines. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Saranapanhara hamlet, PHC Kajipatna under Mangalpur, Block Pipili. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. PHC Mangalpur staff set up camp at the affected village for case management and to conduct active surveillance in the area to find new cases. Halogens tablets, ORS packets and anti-diarrhoeal medicines distributed among the affected villagers. IEC activities undertaken by the health supervisor regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Rajagopal Kandigai, PHC Somangalam, Block Kundrathur. Water sample sent for bacteriological analysis; result awaited. Door to door surveillance done for new cases. Chlorination of water sources done. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Vill: Arrah Danga GP-Bramhandiha SC-Fulkushma ,INPUR Block. . Block RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. and treated 54 diarrhoea patients in the locality. They distributed Anti- Diarrhoeal medicine and Halozone tabs. among the villagers.

Outbreak reported from Natungram, Kanaipur Missionpara, Bali GP. Block RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water source disinfection / Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. IEC activities undertaken. Regarding hygienic and sanitation.
Outbreak reported from Chhatinasole High School Under Gopiballavpur BPHC. Ors, Metronidazole, Norfloxacin, Ofloxacion,Ciprofloxacion, And Phenyl , Bleaching.

Central and State Health teams with ACDMO from East district visited the affected areas of Mayur Vihar Phase-III. On active survey, 22 cases of jaundice were detected. The East District health team has been mobilized to the affected area to treat cases and conduct daily house to house survey in the affected areas. Cases treated symptomatically. Sera samples were collected from suspected cases and sent to NCDC, Delhi for serological test; 7 out of 11 samples were confirmed positive for HEV and 2 tested positive for HAV at NCDC lab. Water samples found contaminated. Chlorination of water sources done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation due to consumption of contaminated water. Sera samples sent to Microbiology lab in VSGH for serological test; out of 18 sera samples sent from West Zone 17 tested positive for HEV, out of 6 sera samples sent from Central Zone all tested positive for HEV, and out of 5 sera samples sent from North Zone all tested positive for HEV. Chlorination of water sources done and chlorine tablets distributed among households. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures. In West zone (total 132 cases/1 death) affected areas include neighboring areas of Rabarivas, Thakorvas, Parmarvas, Shamalbhai, Nichali, Durgachowk in Kaligam, New Westzone (64 cases); and from Subashnagar, Vishnunagar, Janatnagar, Shivshaktinagar in Chandkheda Ward (37 cases/1 death); and from Ankur Falt, Alok Appartment, Sabar Apartment, Mostisagar Society, Harsanti Society, Rang Sagar Apartment, Mahima Apartment, Sonya Flat, Dharmendra Society, Paresh Apartment in Vasna Ward (31 cases). In Central zone (108 cases) the affected areas include Daulatkhana, Bagdawad, Pakhali ni pol, Fafda, ni Pol, Vithhalsheri, Lalji, Maharaj nuchokthu, Naivado, Navo Vas, Kanchvado, Koth ni Pol of Khadiya ward. In North zone (31 cases) the affected areas include Chuval Nagar, Shivshakti Nagar, Kumbhaji Ni Chali Ni Kubernagar Ward.

Outbreak reported from Village Bhinar, PHC Sagra, Block Jalalpore, due to consumption of contaminated water. Drinking water samples found contaminated. All patients treated at CHC Maroli. House to house surveillance, pot and well chlorination and case management done at local level. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Chaturi, PHC Khadadhar, Taluka Khambha, Block Dhari due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Contaminated food was discarded and not available for lab analysis. All cases treated. ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever and jaundice reported from Visnagar City (12 cases) and Village Kuvsana (14 cases), SC Gagharet, PHC Gothava, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Sera samples not collected for lab test. Chlorine tablets distributed among the affected villagers. Water pipeline leakages repaired in affected area. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from 80 Feet Raod, Kumkum Society, Desalnagar Gayatri Park, Gokul Nagar, Hare Krishna Soceity, Alkapuri Chowk, Sanghvi Park, Noor Mohammad Soceity, near Raj Hotel, Ambedkar Nagar, Alankar Talkies Sub Jail area, Dudhrej Ganapati Fatser Urban area of Surendranagar and Wadhwan Nagarpalika probably due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in water pipeline. Out of 7 serum samples sent for Viral marker study at Microbiology lab, BJMC Ahmedabad, six samples tested positive for HEV and one for HAV. Active surveillance being done for new cases. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Kempayanpur, PHC Sante Marahalli/ Kempayanpura/Nadakalmole, Taluka Chamarajanaga. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. The cases were clustered in the Upparashattaru street in neighboring houses. Majority of cases are children under 5 yrs of age. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Cases reported from Village Kalyanpura, Thenkanidiyooru, PHC Kemmannu, Uppunda, Taluka Byndoor. All cases are children of school. Sera samples tested positive for Chicken pox at KMC Manipal. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding providing proper nutrition, isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Antarbharati tanda Village, CHC Hulsoor, Taluka Basawakalyan. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Out of 5 blood samples collected for Chikungunya; 1 sample tested positive for Chikungunya. 22 blood smears collected for malaria; result awaited. 24x7 clinics set up in the affected area to treat cases. Mass fever survey and entomological surveillance done. Aedes larva found in every house. As the house index crosses the critical index, "Dry Day" practice advised and strictly source reduction measures carried out in and around the affected village to control the transmission. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the community.

Cases with symptoms of fever and thrombocytopenia reported from Trivandrum Medical College Hospital, TVM Corporation area. 20 cases are house surgeons in TMCH and tested IgM positive for dengue at Microbiology Lab, MCH, Trivandrum. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Few beading sources identified during inspection. Fogging done once every week and periodic vector survey advised. Source reduction conducted by District Vector Control Unit, TVM every week. Health education imparted regarding early treatment of cases, personal protection measures of others and vector control activities in the area.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from Seppa Town, East Kameng due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Sanawad, Shahpura, Block Barwaha, Gagawan, Kasrawad (17 cases) and from Village Basner (10 cases). All cases are in the age group of 11 months to 10 years. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children. Serum samples collected and sent for lab confirmation; result awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak with fever and rash reported from Darjeeling/Siliguri/Phansidewa/Chathat, SC ChanchPara, Phansidewa/Laldas SC Hatiram, Matigara/Matigara SC. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding providing proper nutrition and early treatment of cases and personal protection measures of unaffected population.

Outbreak of fever with conjunctivitis and rash reported from Rampur, Bharha ward no. 13 & 14. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. All cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases and hygienic practices.

Outbreak reported from overcrowded areas of Hafiaganj, Zafarganj Purab and Zafarganj Paschimtola. Diagnosis is based on clinical features of fever with typical rash. PHC medical team visited the affected area, treated cases symptomatically and educated people regarding preventive measures of chickenpox and hygienic practices.

Cases of fever with rash reported from Khargwara village, PHC Ramgarh Chowk. Active surveillance done by district RRT to find new cases. All cases are below 12 years of age. Symptomatic treatment provided. Vitamin-A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Cases with mild fever and swelling of gland below the ear, clinically diagnosed as mumps, reported from Khargwara village, PHC Ramgarh Chowk. Active surveillance done by district RRT to find new cases. All cases are children below 12 years of age. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village/Block Thasra, PHC Sevaliya due to consumption of contaminated water. Out of 8 water samples tested, 6 were not portable. Active surveillance of affected area done to find new cases and to detect leakages in water pipeline. Chlorination of water sources done. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from neighboring villages of Gnaither, Hamirpar, Belia, Bhimsrb, Adesar PHC Gagodar, Block Rapar. Block Health Officer with PHC medical team visited the affected area and conducted active survey to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Outbreak of fever with rash reported from Village/PHC Doddullarthi, Taluka Chalkere. Index case reported from Mahatma Gandhi school near to Chalkere. PHC Medical officer informed about clustering of chickenpox cases in Doddullarthi village. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 2 sera samples collected from cases and sent to KMC, Manipal. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Doddullarthi, PHC Doddullarthi, Taluka Chalkere due to consumption of contaminated water. No sanitary facilities available in the affected area. District RRT visited the area and investigated the outbreak. Out of 8 stool samples collected for lab analysis, 1 tested positive for V. cholerae. Food samples were not available for lab test. Health education given to the villagers not to eat stale food items.

Outbreak reported from St. Anns High School, Near Rayavaram Railway Station, Markapur Town, Gajjalakonda PHC due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited the affected area and undertook control measures. Kitchen and hostel premises inspected and instructions given to cooks regarding hygienic practices in food preparation and safe food handling. Medical camp conducted and affected students treated with IV fluids. Food samples not available for lab investigation. Students advised regarding maintaining personnel hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Rakodu PHC, Chillapeta Village, Duppada Panchayat due to consumption of contaminated water. Stool and water samples sent for investigation to PH lab, Visakhapatnam; results awaited. Chlorination of drinking water supply done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases with symptoms of nausea and vomiting reported from a summer camp at Village Raybag town, Block Raybag two hours after consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited the affected area. Food samples (rice and sambar) were sent to PHI Bangalore; lab results awaited. All cases were admitted to a private hospital for treatment. House to house survey done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from Village Chouli, PHC Andoor, Block Bidar. District RRT visited the affected area. 2 sera samples collected and sent to Bidar Medical College; lab result is awaited. Fogging activities and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protective measures.

Cases reported from Village Basavan Sangolagi, PHC Thadakal, Block Aland due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house search done to find new cases. Two stool samples tested positive for Vibrio cholerae (Eltor Ogawa). Halogen tablets distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures. Disinfection of all water sources advised in the areas.

Cases reported from Village Monnageri, PHC Cherembane, Taluka Madikeri due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Out of 5 water samples collected, 2 samples found not potable. ORS packets and Halogen tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Itagi, PHC Yalburga, Block Gowral Yalburga. Water logging in the affected area led to high density of mosquitoes causing the outbreak. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Out of 14 blood samples collected, 11 were positive for P. vivax and 3 positive for P. falciparum. Mass fever survey done by house to house visit. DDT sprayed and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding prevention of Malaria by adopting personal protective measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Alathuru Hundi, PHC Hosakote, Block Nanjangudu due to consumption of contaminated water from broken pipeline. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Water pipelines were repaired and chlorination of water sources done. House to house survey done to find new cases. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Village Harohalli, PHC Varuna Hobli, Mallahalli, Block Mysore due to consumption of contaminated water caused from broken pipelines. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Out of 14 stool samples collected, 3 were positive for V. cholerae by culture. All cases treated with fluids, anti-emetics and antibiotics. Water pipelines were repaired and chlorination of water sources done. House to house survey done to find new cases and ORS packets distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Umaluvigram, PHC Turvihala, Taluka Sindhanoor due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 4 water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Distribution of ORS packets and Halogen tablets done. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever reported from Joakhori, PHC Shinde, Block Jakohri. Epidemiological investigation carried out on 18.04.11 revealed improper sanitary and garbage disposal methods in the affected area leading to water stagnation and high density of mosquito (Anopheles/Culex) breeding. Out of 61 peripheral blood smears of fever cases examined, 2 found positive for P. falciparum. Five blood samples sent to NIV Pune for investigation; result awaited. House to house active fever survey and entomological survey done in the area. All fever cases administered prophylactic Chloroquine. Insecticides sprayed in the area. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protective measures.

Cases reported from Village Gawadi Darfal, PHC Wadala, Block North Solapur. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples sent for lab test; result is awaited. Chlorination of water advised and chlorine tablets distributed. Defects in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with loose watery stool and mild dehydration reported from Village Parepada, PHC Wangaon, Block Dahanu. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Out of 4 stool samples sent for investigation, 3 tested positive for V. cholerae. Cases treated at Wangaon PHC. Active house to house survey done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Hinduan, Matka Kuli, Local Idgha Colony. Medical team sent to Razzak Nagar for treating cases with anit-diarrhoeal drugs and fluids. Water and stool samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed among the affected people. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Karumbur, PHC Craiyur, Block Annagiramam. House to house survey done for new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and maintaining hygienic practices while cooking food.

Cases reported from Village/ PHC/Block K.M.Patti due to consumption of contaminated water. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Overhead tanks cleaned and chlorinated. Block Health team investigated the outbreak. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak of jaundice with fever reported from Haridwar town. Serum bilirubin levels found elevated in all cases. All cases are factory workers consuming water from the same source. The drinking water was contaminated, as evidenced by negative OT test of the water sample collected. Factory management advised to chlorinate the drinking water sources. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water and sanitation measures.

Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from GP Mosiara, SC Amjhuri, Block Hirbandh due to consumption of contaminated food. Block health team visited the affected area and treated cases in the locality. Prompt reporting to the BPHC advised. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Bishnupur, GP-Herampur, Block Raninagar-I. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Cases treated symptomatically. Active house to house search done to find cases in the community. Vitamin A solution given to affected children. IEC done on case handling and importance of isolation of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Krishnamati, SC Kundhuni, Kirtipur-I GP, Barasat-II Block due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water and stool samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak of fever with rash, clinically diagnosed as measles, reported from Darjeeling, Kurseong, Sukna, Sittong. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Cases presented with loose stool, vomiting and pain abdomen from Kotal Para, SC Belkash, Kurmum BPHC. District RRT visited the affected area. Water samples and rectal swab specimens collected for lab test; result awaited. Symptomatic treatment given. Disinfection of water sources done. IEC activities conducted regarding proper hand washing and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever with headache reported from Village Saragli, PHC Gerusoppa, Taluka Honnavara. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 2 sera samples tested positive for KFD by ELISA. Heavy tick infestation and incomplete vaccination of villagers found in the area. Tick repellants distributed among villagers and KFD vaccine given. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Cases of fever with altered sensorium reported from Village Arattupuzha Municipal area, PHC Arattupuzha, Block Muthukulame. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Entomological survey done in and around the affected area showed high density breeding of JE vectors like Culex vishnoi and C. gelidus etc. at stagnant water pools in the area. Serum samples collected from 11 fever cases and tested in NIV Alapuzha showed 3 cases positive for JE IgM antibodies. Application of larvicides like abate was done in all the water logged areas. Fogging activities carried out in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the community like use of ITBN, etc.

Cases with fever and typical rash reported from village Mithapur, GP Majhergram, SC Ujirpukur, Block Ranaghat-II. Block level medical team visited the affected area and treated cases symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Purmakanahalli, Subcentre Kuntur, PHC Tekal, Taluka Malur due to consumption of contaminated food during Ramanavami festival. District RRT visited the affected area. Rectal swab samples tested negative for cholera and water samples found unfit for consumption. ORS packets distributed among the households. Cases managed at temporary clinic setup in the affected village, at PHC Doddashivara and at General Hospital, Malur. House to house survey carried out for active search of cases. Health education given on personal hygiene and environmental sanitation.

Cases of cutaneous anthrax reported from village Nowsapara, Berhampur, GP Madanpur (8 cases) and from villages Gojnipur, Mada Tala, Hariharpara (6 cases). District RRT with block health team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Out of 11 smears collected and sent to DPH Lab for investigation; 1smear found positive for Anthracis bacillus and result of 5 other smears is awaited. Active survey done to find new cases. All cases treated with Ciprofloxacin. The Animal Husbandry Dept. instructed to vaccinate all cattle. IEC activities going on regarding handling of potentially contaminated articles, their proper disposal, personal cleanliness etc.

Cases reported with symptoms of loose motion, nausea and vomiting, from Village Kumrai, Burwan GP Kuli, a few hours after consumption of contaminated food (sweet) sold by a street hawker. District RRT with block health team visited the area for preliminary investigation and for new case search. Two stool samples collected and sent to District PH Lab for investigation; lab result awaited. Cases admitted at Kandi SD Hospital for treatment. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene maintenance. Prompt reporting has been ensured.

Cases with fever and rash reported from GP Patkata, SC Natunpara, PHC Rangdhamali under Block Sadar. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Cases are children below 10 years of age. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. Measles vaccination given to the unimmunized children in the age-group of 9 months to 5 years. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases reported from Meerjapuram, PHC Digavali, Nuzvid Block due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done to find new cases. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. Food samples (wheat flour, edible oil) collected for lab analysis, result awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Vijayawada Municipal Corporation (Sundaraiah Nagar, Rajiv Nagar, Prakash Nagar, Prajasakthi Nagar, Kandrika, Payakapuram, Vamba Colony, Radhanagar and LBS Nagar) due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool samples sent to Siddhartha Medical College, Vijayawada; results awaited. Health staff deputed to treat cases. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases under supervision of Corporation Medical Officers. Chlorination of water advised and halogen tablets distributed. Alternate safe water supplied in the affected areas. Heath education given regarding proper hand washing and personal hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Village Thippayyapalli, PHC:Pullampet due to consumption of contaminated food (Prasad) during Srinamanavami Utsav. District RRT visited the affected area and undertook control measures. Food samples not available for lab analysis. House to house survey done for new cases. IEC activities carried out regarding food safety and personnel hygiene.

Outbreak of fever with arthralgia reported from Village Rangapur, PHC Mogullapally. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak. 4 sera samples tested positive for Dengue IgM ELISA. All cases treated. Active surveillance done by paramedical staff. Fogging activities and anti-larval measures undertaken in affected area. Health education given regarding personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Villages Puthimari, Dalimorvita and Singimari BPHC Nityananda, due to contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house search done to find new cases in the affected area. Out of two stool sample collected for culture, one showed growth of Vibrio cholerae and out of 9 water samples tested, 7 samples showed fecal contamination. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Namsishu Tea Estate, Namsishu Bongal village, BPHC Nakachari, Salenghat, due to consumption of contaminated water. Medical camp held and cases treated with ORS. Stool samples sent to Jorhat Medical College Hospital for lab analysis; result showed growth of Esch. coli only. PHE Department intimated to carry out chlorination of drinking water sources. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with symptoms of vomiting and pain abdomen reported from Kukurjan, Rupnagar (Urban Area, Ward No. 4), Gohpur BPHC, due to consumption of contaminated food (Mushroom). District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool sample collected for lab test, results awaited. Seriously ill cases were treated at Civil Hospital. House to house surveillance done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety.

Cases of fever with typical rash reported from Sub Centre Belwa, Pothiyaghat, Tapka, Block Kathihar Sadar. Diagnosis is based on clinical features only and sera sample not collected for lab test. Most cases are in the age-group of 3-6 years. Control measures undertaken to prevent secondary infection. Health education given regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village/Subcentre Gana, PHC Navli, Block Anand, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. Water pipelines repaired in the affected area. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village/Subcentre Vasna, PHC Bhadran, Block Anklav. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from Village Khanpur, PHC Kotadapitha, Block Babrara. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Serum sample collected and sent to Sir T. Hospital and Medical College, Bhavnagar; result awaited. Active surveillance done for new cases. Aedes larvae found in the water storage containers. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control measures in the community and personal protection measures.

Outbreak of fever and jaundice reported from Village/Subcentre Panchot, PHC Chatiyarada, Block Mehsana. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 8 sera samples collected were positive for Anti- HAV IgM. Daily active surveillance done to find new cases. All cases treated and followed up. Super chlorination of water sources done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures like proper disposal of waste.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from Village Viona, Sub centre Vina, PHC Yoginagar,. Block Nadiad. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. 5 Serum sample collected and sent to NHL Medical College, Ahmedabad, result awaited. Active fever surveillance for cases done. Entomological survey revealed Aedes larvae in water storage containers. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control measures in the community and personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Village/Subcentre Gutal, PHC Aakhdol, Block Nadiad due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area. 3 sera samples sent to NHL Medical College, Ahmedabad tested positive for Viral Hepatitis A (Anti-HAV IgM). Daily active surveillance done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Kesharpura, PHC Jasvantgadhm, Block Idar. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Active house to house search done to find new cases in the affected area. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever with typical rash reported from Village Jajru. Diagnosis is based on clinical features only and sera sample not collected for lab test. Most cases are in the age-group of 3-6 years. Control measures undertaken to prevent secondary infection. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases reported from village Balmiki Basti, Sub Centre/PHC Jalmana, CHC Assandh. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak. 7 serum sample collected for sent to NCDC Delhi; out of which 6 were positive for IgM ELISA. All cases were given symptomatic treatment and Vitamin -A. Active surveillance being done in the affected as well as near by village.

Outbreak of fever with typical rash diagnosed clinically as Chickenpox reported from village Kotekere, PHC Begur, Block Gundlupet. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding early treatment and isolation of cases.

Cases reported from Village Mettinahole, Sub Centre Kellodu, PHC Devigere, Block Hosdurga due to water contamination. . District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 3 Stool and 4 water samples collected 1 positive for Cholera culture. Active house to house search done to find new cases in the affected area. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Shanthgiri, PHC Shanthgiri, Block Ron. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected sent to KIMS Hubli; result awaited. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. Water pipelines repaired in the affected area. Alternate drinking water supply arranged. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Dyavappanahalli, PHC Chatchatnahalli, Block Belur due to water contamination. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected, lab result awaited. Alternate drinking water supply arranged. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Village Bekkere¸ PHC Komalapura, Block Periyapatna due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT with Block medical team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected sent to District Referral Lab; result awaited. Raw and cooked food materials collected and sent to Divisional Food Lab, Mysore; results awaited. All cases treated. Health education given regarding food sanitation and hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Village Kampanahalli, PHC Dasudi, Block C.N.Halli. District RRT Team visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Medical team deployed in the affected area to treat cases. Active surveillance by house to house visit done to find new fever cases. 24 blood slides were positive for P. vivax and 1 blood slide positive for P. falciparum. IEC activities undertaken regarding prevention of Malaria by adopting personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from PHC Kodandavoor, Block Malpe. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Medical team deployed in the affected area to treat cases. Active surveillance by house to house visit done to find new fever cases. 11 blood slides were positive for P. falciparum and 1 blood slide positive for P. vivax. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Village Kaniyambetta, Subcenter Arimula, PHC Varadoor, Block Varadoor due to consumption of contaminated food in marriage function. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. House to house survey conducted to find new cases. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Padmapur, Block Balipatna, due to consumption of contaminated (Rotten fish) in the marriage function. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. House to house survey conducted to find new cases. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Siruli, PHC Siruli, Block Chandanpur. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Teja patti, Block Sittogunno, probably due to contaminated water. Cases presented with fever, vomiting, jaundice and abdominal pain. 10 blood samples collected and sent to Faridkot Medical College, results awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Seedpur, Andaua Ka Nagla, Tiya Ka Nagla, PHC Brahmbad, subcentre Seedpur, Block Bayana due to consumption of contaminated food (ice-cream). District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Most cases are in the age-group of 1-12 years. All cases admitted at CHC Bayana for treatment. Active house to house survey conducted in the affected area. Direction given to food inspector to collect suspected food (ice-cream) samples. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and food safety.

Cases reported among family members from Paota due to consumption of contaminated food (stale fruits). One family member severely affected. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and personal hygiene.
Cases with fever and rash reported from Neemala CHC Andhi. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding providing isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Block Raisinghnagar probably due to consumption of contaminated food during a social ceremony. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Medical camps organized in the affected area treat cases. ORS packets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Block Shadulsahar, Gram Karadwala. Symptoms of vomiting and pain abdomen started after consumption of stale and contaminated food. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. House to house surveillance done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from village N. Karaiyiruppu, RSA Nagar, Sundarapuram, PHC Thatchanallur, Block Reddiarpatti (Palayankottai) due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area. House to house survey done. Water samples from overhead tank collected for lab test. Corporation authority advised to clean the tanks and supply safe drinking water. Out of 6 stool samples sent to Microbiology Department, Tirunelveli Medical College for culture, 4 samples found positive for V. cholerae. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Mathireddipatti, PHC Esanatham. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 3 serum samples were collected and sent to Trichy ZET, all the samples tested positive for Dengue. Active fever surveillance for cases done. Entomological survey revealed Aedes larvae in water storage containers. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control measures in the community and personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Village Nadia Tehatta SD Karimpur-II, Block Natiganga-I, GP Kalupur, Laxmipur. Block medical team visiting regularly to affected villages. All cases treated with antibiotics. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Easta & Makalpur Subcentre, under Makalpur GP, Polba Block, District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool samples collected for lab analysis found positive for V. cholarae O1 Ogawa. Water sources disinfected and Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among the villagers. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Chuliarbarli, GP Dharmapuri, PHC Bhurungarbari, Block Maynaguri, due to consumption of contaminated stale food. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Active search of cases done. Treatment and distribution of ORS packet done. Food samples not available for lab analysis.

Cases reported from Village Nowdapara, Berhampur, GP Madanpuri. Block health team along with Epidemiologist and Microbiologist visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Out of 5 smears collected and sent to DPH Lab for investigation; Anthrax bacillus found in 3 smears. All the cases treated with antibiotics. Animal Husbandry department has been informed for cattle vaccination. IEC activities done regarding handling of potentially contaminated articles, their proper disposal and personal cleanliness.

Cases presented with diarrhoea and vomiting from village Gowdapalem, Siripudi Gram Panchayat, Block Nagaram due to consumption of contaminated food (Prasad) during Srinamanavami Utsav. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Temporary health camp established at affected village to treat cases. Out of 3 water samples collected, 2 samples were positive for Esch. coli. House to house survey conducted to find new cases. Health education given regarding food hygiene.

Cases with fever and rash, clinically diagnosed as Measles, reported from PHC Kidana, City Kandala (Sarva), Block Anjar. All cases treated symptomatically by PHC Medical Officer and advised isolation at home. 5 serum samples collected and sent to BJ Medical College, results awaited. Vitamin A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Village Satlasana, CHC Satasana, Block Kheralu, due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Cases treated. Health education given regarding safe food and hygienic practices.

Cases with fever and rash, clinically diagnosed as Measles, reported from Village Taravda, Sub Centre Medapur, PHC Derolgam, Block Kalol. All cases treated symptomatically by PHC Medical Officer and advised isolation at home. Vitamin A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Sardi,, Subcentre Khadol, PHC Akrund, Block Modasa due to contaminated water. District RRT Team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 2 Stool and 1 Water sample collected and sent to B.J. Medical College, result awaited. Cases treated at PHC and Rural Hospital, Modasa. Community advised regarding proper and regular chlorination of water sources. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Kale, Block Panutre, due to contaminated water and water leakage. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with jaundice, fever and vomiting reported from Village Hervad, Block Shirol probably due to contaminated water supply. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Active house to house survey conducted by medical and paramedical team to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation. Super chlorination of drinking water sources of affected area done.

Cases of fever reported from village Gimare, PHC Dhaiwad, Block Deola. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in affected area. All 63 blood samples collected were found negative for Malaria and Chikungunya. 5 samples sent to NIV Pune for lab testing for Dengue and Chikungunya; results awaited. Fogging, source reduction and anti-larval measures undertaken. Health education given regarding personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Shergarh & Ossian. District RRT investigated outbreak. Active survey done for new cases in the community. Measles vaccination done among unimmunized children between 6 month to 5 yrs of age, and Vitamin-A solution also administered. Health education given advising proper isolation of the cases and to maintain proper hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Deoli, Sub Centre Bharja Nadi, PHC Bhadoti,. Block Bonli. All cases treated symptomatically by PHC Medical Officer and advised isolation at home. 5 sera samples collected and sent to SMS Hospital, Jaipur, results awaited. Vitamin-A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of the cases.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Muragacha, Matpara, Lohagacha, Subcentre Himpara, Block Nakashipara. Block health team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. All cases treated symptomatically by PHC Medical Officer and advised isolation at home. Vitamin-A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Dharmajigudem Choutuppal Mandal, PHC Varkatpally due to consumption of contaminated food (chicken curry). Health staff conducted camp in the affected village to treat cases. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation and personal hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Kallur, Ulindakonda PHC due to consumption of contaminated water. Water and stool samples collected for lab test; result awaited. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed among the village people. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Gurukul School Hostel Tezpur, Tin Mile, Sonitpur Panchmilwe NPHC, Bihaguri BPHC due to consumption of contaminated food (Chicken dish). District RRT with the food inspector visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed among the village people. All cases treated. Drinking water sources chlorinated. IEC activities like awareness meeting conducted in the hostel premises.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from Village Sakola, Gohapur BPHC, Rownamukh NPHC due to consumption of contaminated water. Open air defecation is prevalent in the area and river water is the only drinking water source in the affected area. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Mobile Medical Unit, Tezpur mobilized to the affected Gohpur area to treat cases. Cholera control room opened in Gohpur PHC with 24 hrs services. Cholera Treatment Unit opened in the affected villages. 5 stool samples collected and sent for culture to Microbiological deptt. GMCH, Guwahati, showed growth of V. cholerae. Fecal contamination found in five water samples from different sources by HS strip test. Active 2 house to house survey conducted to find new cases and ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. All cases treated. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Mackeypur Tea Estate (TE) and Santak TE under BHPC Galeky, due to consumption of contaminated water. Medical team from Nazira SHC visited the affected area, treated cases and organized health awareness camp. PHE Department intimated to carry out chlorination of drinking water sources. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak of diarrhoea, abdominal pain and vomiting reported from Village Vastikhandalli, SC Saladara, PHC Pakhajan, Block Vagra. Stool samples collected and sent to Medical College Vadodara, and water samples sent to WASMO, Bharuch for bacteriological test; result awaited. Chlorination of wells and water tanks done. House to house survey done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village/SC Kahnava, PHC Gajera, Block Jambusar due to consumption of contaminated food at a marriage ceremony. Active house to house survey done. Medical camp held and cases treated promptly. IEC activities undertaken regarding food sanitation and personal hygiene.

Cases with abdominal pain and vomiting reported from Village Gangapura, SC Hamidpura, PHC Bharoda, Block Umreth due to consumption of contaminated food at a marriage ceremony. Food and Drug department undertook sampling of food, and the leftover food was destroyed. Active surveillance done by medical officer and staff. 45 cases treated on OPD basis and 82 cases admitted in nearby hospital and CHC for treatment. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting occurred in Village/SC Vasna, PHC Bahadran, Block Anklav due to consumption of contaminated food. Food samples not available for lab analysis. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases of fever reported from village Dhodhipada, Maroli, PHC Maroli under Block Umergram, among workers of a brick-furnace. 10 cases are admitted at Civil Hospital, Valsad. Out of 10 blood samples collected, 3 tested positive for Malaria (P. vivax). Paramedical staff deputed to the affected area for active surveillance. Fogging activities and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from village Sultanpur, SC Kakru, PHC Panjkokhera, Block Chaurmastpur. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water samples collected from the affected area; result awaited. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected villagers. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Khurdhan, under PHC Alahar, CHC Radaur, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area. Water samples taken from locality for OT testing. House to house survey conducted by the medical and paramedical teams. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. People advised to boil water before using it for drinking purpose, and to maintain hygiene and wash hands before taking food.

Cases reported from village Kalligurppa, PHC Bethamangala due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Out of 6 stool samples collected for lab test, one tested positive for V. cholerae. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected people. Alternate safe drinking water supplied by Gram Panchayat. House to house survey done to find new cases. Health education given to people regarding personal hygiene and food hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Chanabahal, GP/SC Raiboga due to consumption of contaminated food (egg-curry). District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Medical team of Kuarumunda CHC conducted camp in the affected area and treated cases. ORS packets distributed among the affected villagers. Health education given to people regarding personal hygiene and food sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Miani, PHC Tanda due to leakage of water supply pipeline. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples sent for lab investigation to CMC Ludhiana; result awaited. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation. Water pipeline repair work started by the concerned authorities.

Cases with fever and vesicular rash reported from Govt. Senior. Secondary, Aulakh, Panjgrain Kalan. Survey of four schools done in the area to detect contact with fresh cases. Cases treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding isolation and treatment of cases.

Cases reported from Village Kasturibai Gandhi Palicaka Vidhylaya School, Chittoor, PHC/Block Chittoor. All affected cases are school children. Food sample collected and sent to GMC, Salem; result awaited. House to house survey done to find new cases. Disinfection of water sources done. Health education given about hand wash, safe drinking water and environmental sanitation.

Cases reported from Nainital Town and adjoining areas. Active search and containment measures are being taken. Distribution of chlorine tablets done in affected and adjoining areas by the health staff, Health education about personal and food hygiene and use of boiled water stressed. Patient receiving treatment at BD Pandey District Hospital, Nainital.

Outbreak reported from Village/SC Gutal, PHC Aakhdol, Block Nadiad due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 3 sera samples sent to NHL Medical College, Ahmedabad tested positive for Viral Hepatitis A (Anti-HAV IgM reactive). IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak of fever with rash, clinically diagnosed as measles, reported from Darjeeling, Kurseong, Sukna, Sittong, Siliguri. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Outbreak reported from Technical Training and Development Centre (TTDC), Rapthadu PHC due to consumption of contaminated food. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.
Cases of fever, cough and typical rash reported from Haridyapur Dhama Ward no. 10. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Rumla, PHC Achhavali, Block Chikhli due to consumption of contaminated food at a marriage ceremony. Food samples collected by Food Inspector and sent for lab testing; result awaited. Active surveillance done to find new cases. ORS packets distributed among the cases. Cases managed at Rumla and CHC Chikhli. Contaminated food was destroyed.

Cases reported from Village/SC Karachia, PHC Samalaya, Block Savali. 4 cases admitted in CHC Savali and 4 admitted in Private hospital at Savali. 2 Stool samples sent to Microbiology Lab., Medical college Vadodara found negative for cholera. Water samples sent for lab analysis found contaminated. House to house survey done. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. Leakages found in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village / CHC / Block Ratnal. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house surveillance done. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. Leakages found in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Kamanayakanahalli, PHC Narayanapura, Taluka Pandavapura due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 4 stool samples collected found positive for V. cholerae. House to house survey done. Chlorine tablets distributed among the households. Cases treated with ORS. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Reddyhalli, PHC Avani, Block Mulbagal due to consumption of contaminated food during village Gangammana Jatha. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. Cases managed at General Hospital, Mulbagal and PHC Avani. House to house survey carried out for active search of cases. Health education given on personal hygiene, environmental sanitation and consumption of safe drinking water and food.

Cases of fever reported from SC Vatapalli, Yeragunta, PHC Yappal Dinne, Taluka Raichur. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Blood samples collected for testing for Dengue and Malaria; result awaited. House to house surveillance done.
