Fogging activities and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the community.

Cases of fever reported from Village/PHC Alagilawada under Harappanahalli Taluka. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Out of 13 blood samples tested, 4 found positive for P. falciparum. Fogging and source reduction measures undertaken. Health education given regarding personal protection measures to be adopted by the community.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from Village Hiremagadur, PHC Kalasur, Taluka Savanur due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result is awaited. Halogen tablets distributed and chlorination of water sources done. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village / PHC Konnur, Taluka Gokak due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. Field investigation done to determine the cause of outbreak. Alternative safe drinking water made available. Halogen tablets and ORS supplied house to house. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Haronahalli, PHC Mallasandra, Block Tumkur due to water contamination. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water and stool samples sent for lab analysis; result awaited. Halogen tablets and ORS distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported among students from Corporation Area due to consumption of contaminated food (fried fish). District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. All cases are in the age group of 10-15 years. 4 children referred for treatment to Medical College Hospital. Health education given to food handlers and children.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from village Chigam, PHC Karahi, Block Maheshwar. Blood samples collected for testing for Chikungunya; report awaited. Paramedical staff deputed to the affected area for active surveillance. Source reduction measures undertaken. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the community.

Outbreak reported from Village Shankargarh, Tarana, Block Makdon due to consumption of contaminated food (Ice-cream) at a social house function. Food and drug department collected the sample and sent to lab for testing; result awaited. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases reported from Village-Husanpura, PHC Chanarthal Kalan, Bhadochi Kalan due to consumption of contaminated food (curd). All cases admitted in Civil Hospital Fatehgarh Sahib Civil Hospital for treatment. Health education given regarding food safety.

Cases presented with symptoms of abdomen pain, diarrhea and vomiting from Village Peelwa, CHC Sikandra, Block Dausa due to consumption of contaminated food (sweets) at a marriage party. District RRT with Medical team visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Samples of food and water taken and sent to lab; report is awaited.

Outbreak reported from SC Nirwana in Dhani, Block Suratgarh due to consumption of contaminated stale food in the marriage function in the village. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak in the affected area. Food and water samples collected and sent to PHED Lab. Sri Ganganagar for bacteriological analysis; result is awaited. Chlorination of drinking water done. Left over food destroyed. All cases treated.

Outbreak ofdiarrhoea and vomiting reported from Amer, Jahota, Rampur Dabdi, Tantiya Awas due to consumption of contaminated food. Suspected food items destroyed and safe drinking water provided. Food samples collected for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food safety.
Cases with vomiting reported from Bassi, Sujanpura, Doodhli due to consumption of contaminated food. Food samples taken for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting occurred in the Mortury area, Kalogiri Hospital near Situ Palaza, Malviya Nagar due to consumption of contaminated food. Medical team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area, treated cases and investigated the outbreak. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Vill. Bhopar, SC Sita, CHC Weir, Bhusawar, 7-8 hour after consumption of contaminated sweets (Jalabi, Laddu, & Dal ki Chandiya). Cases presented with symptoms of abdomen pain, diarrhea and vomiting. Medical teams sent to village Bhopar and all cases treated. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Food and water samples sent to laboratory; result awaited. Door to door survey conducted and health education given to villagers through IEC activities. Remaining food destroyed.
Cases with fever and rash reported from Labdang under Yoksum PHC, West Sikkim. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases with fever and joint pain reported from Village Ramalingapuram (MGR Nagar Colony). High density Aedes vector breeding found in the area. Out of 6 blood samples collected five found positive for Dengue for IgM ELISA. Fogging operation is conducted by Medical team. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Indira Nagar due to consumption of contaminated food. 10 stool sample collected and sent to Thanjavur Medical College Hospital for analysis; result awaited. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases reported from village S.Earipalayam, Block Panruti (14 cases) and from village Akkadavalli, under Block Annagrimam (14 cases) due to consumption of contaminated water. Sewage collection found near public taps. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting occurred at Vill. Brajaballavpur-1, under Block Patharpratima due to consumption of contaminated food (Rosogolla). Cases treated at Brajaballavpur PHC. 94 severely ill cases hospitalized. District RRT visited the affected area, treated cases and investigated the outbreak. Health education given regarding food sanitation and personal hygiene.

Cases with typical rash reported from Village Barpara, SC Ghandal, Chiponsita MPHC, PHC Bongaigaon. Medical Officer of Chiponsila MPHC visited the affected area along with the paramedical staff. Treatment of cases done with Acyclovir. Active search done in the affected area for new cases. Health education given to the community in the affected area.

Outbreak of fever reported from PHC Mankunia, Block Vansda. Blood samples tested positive for P. vivax. Mass fever survey done. Fogging activities and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. Medical team instructed to ensure full radical treatment of all cases. Surveillance intensified in the affected area. Integrated vector management taken up. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures to be adopted by the community.

Outbreak reported from village Solankiyon ka vass, PHC Siwana, was investigated by district RRT. 5 sera samples tested positive for Chikungunya. Pyrethrum sprays done and active house to house survey done in the area to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures to be adopted.

Outbreak reported from BPHC Patsaku, Suffry Tea Estate (TE), Line no. 2, 3 & 4 due to consumption of contaminated water. District Rapid Response Team (RRT) visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water samples tested by HS strip test and stool samples collected and sent to 2 Microbiology Department, AMCH Dibrugarh for lab analysis; result awaited. Active search done in the affected area to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from among a family in village Old Amguri, SC Bhogamguri, Block/PHC Balajan due to consumption of poisonous mushroom. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. All cases treated. Health education given about distinguishing edible and poisonous mushroom.

A female belonging to village Undani, Vadnagar Block, was admitted to Sterling Hospital Ahmedabad and expired on 21.05.11. She was confirmed as a case of Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) by RT-PCR test at NIV, Pune. State Epidemic Team visited the village of the deceased as well as Sterling Hospital. The containment and preventive measures are being undertaken by the Health authorities and the Animal Husbandry department. Serum samples collected from all contacts of the case (Hospital staff and family members) and samples of Ticks (dead and live Ticks) sent to NIV, Pune for lab investigation; result awaited. Animal Husbandry Dept collected cattle sera samples and sent to HSADL Bhopal and NIV, Pune for analysis. Daily fever survey being undertaken in the area. Health education given regarding prevention and control measures to be undertaken by the community.

Cases of fever occurred at village Khadsupa, PHC Adada, Block Navsari. Stagnation of canal water due to overflowing and improper drainage noticed in the area. District RRT visited the affected area. Fever survey done and blood smears of contacts taken. All suspected cases given radical treatment. Larvicide spray done and people advised not to allow stagnation of water in the neighborhood. Health education given regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Outbreak reported from Village/SC/PHC Raner, Block Kankrej due to consumption of contaminated food. Medical Officer with his team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. All cases treated. Active search done for new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Villages Godha, Virpur, PHC Jamala, Block Himatnagar due to consumption of contaminated food. Block health officer along with medical team visited the affected area and undertook necessary action. Stool and vomitus sample collected and sent to B.J. Medical College; result awaited. Water chlorination done and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever without any hemorrhagic manifestation reported from Siddhpur, Kuvara, Dashavada. 5 fever cases admitted at a private hospital for treatment. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Mass fever survey done. Out of 7 serum samples collected for lab test; one tested positive for Dengue (RT-PCR). IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the community.

Outbreak reported from Village/PHC Baniyani due to consumption of contaminated water. All cases treated. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed. Chlorination of water done. Health workers advised to educate the public regarding hygiene, sanitation and safe drinking water.Active case search done in the area.

Outbreak reported from Village Tuttikere and Gottegere, PHC Yadiyur, Taluka Kunigal due to consumption of contaminated food at a marriage party. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected for lab analysis yielded Esch. coli on culture and were negative for cholera. Chlorination of water done. Health education imparted among the affected villagers regarding hygiene, sanitation and food safety.

Cases reported from Village Y-Appareddypalli, PHC Beechaganahlli, Taluka Gudibande due to consumption of contaminated drinking water. Defect in water pipeline caused water contamination due to entry of sewage water into the main pipeline. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Cases treated with ORS, IV fluids and antibiotics. Temporary clinic set up in the village and Gram Panchayat secretary advised to supply chlorinated drinking water. Stool samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea, pain abdomen and vomiting reported from Village/PHC Holalu, Taluka Mandya due to consumption of contaminated food (fermented coconut water). District RRT visited the affected area and investigated outbreak. Stool samples along with food and water samples collected for lab analysis; water samples found contaminated and other reports awaited. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from Village Mundegaon, PHC Wadivarhe, Block Tal Igatouri. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Sera samples collected and sent to NIV, Pune, for testing for Dengue and Chikungunya. Rapid fever survey and container survey done in the area. Entomological survey revealed containers positive for breeding of Aedes aegypti larvae. Application of Abate, fogging and use of Guppy fishes in the water spaces done. Camp arranged at Gram Panchayat to treat cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Outbreak reported from Village/PHC Jogmodi, Block Tal Peth due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water and stool samples collected and sent to DPHL; result awaited. Epidemic medical camp setup at the Aganwadi. Active house to house survey done to find new cases. Water chlorination and OT testing done. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak of fever reported from CHC Kopergaon, Block Chasnalli. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. 8 blood smears found positive for P. vivax. Rapid fever survey and entomological surveillance done. Fogging activities and source reduction measures undertaken in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from the same family of village Mouje biranwadi, Block Tasgao due to consumption of contaminated food (pesticide ). All cases admitted to hospital for treatment. Stool samples collected and food samples sent to SPHL, Pune; result awaited. Health education given regarding hygiene, sanitation and food safety.

Cases reported from Villages Gatidusura, Bhagirathipur, GP/SC Subai, CHC Kunduli, Block Semiliguda. District RRT with the block health team visited affected village and investigated outbreak in the affected area. All cases treated with antibiotics. Animal Husbandry department informed for cattle vaccination. IEC activities undertaken regarding handling of potentially contaminated articles and their proper disposal.

Outbreak reported from Village Bath under Block Mehatpur due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in water pipeline. Out of 7 stool samples collected and sent for lab test, one sample tested positive for V. cholerae. Chlorine tablets distributed. Active house to house survey done to find new cases. Medical camp organized in the affected village. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. IEC activities undertaken regarding prevention of water borne disease.

Outbreak of fever with rash reported from Village Roopnagar, SC Thalkala, PHC Kachola, Block Mandalgarh. Medical team visited the affected area. House to house survey done. 7 blood samples collected and sent to Jaipur; result awaited. All cases are children less than 10 years of age. Vitamin A given to all susceptible children between 9 months to 5 years. Vaccination status of cases being ascertained. Health education given regarding providing proper nutrition, isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak of fever with anemia reported from Chaksu, Kauthoon, Rampura. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Medical staff deputed to the affected area for active surveillance. Blood slides collected for examination; result awaited. Mass fever survey and entomological survey done. Anti larval activities surveillance done. Fogging activities and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Goili, Indira Colony Tehsil and District Sirohi due to consumption of contaminated food. Medical team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water and food samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. All patients treated and recovered. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from among workers of a construction site at village Thiruneermalai, PHC Anagaputhur, Block St. Thomas Mount, due to consumption of contaminated water supplied through water tanker. Water and stool samples collected and sent to King Institute for lab analysis; result awaited. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Kavathukudi, PHC Thiruvegampet, Block Devakottai due to consumption of contaminated water. Water and stool samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. Chlorination of water sources done. Medical team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey done to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases with fever and rash reported from village Baharia and Mailha. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Measles vaccination and vitamin A given to all children, and all sick children treated. Active surveillance done in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment and isolation of cases.

Cases presented with loose motion and vomiting from Village Turang, PO Bijodih, SC Baliguma, Block Manbazar due to consumption of contaminated water and lack of sanitation practices in the area. Water samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. Chlorination of water sources done. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Hamlets Jaybangla Line, Beach Line and Daina Line, GP Sulkapara, SC Bamandanga, Block Nagrakata, due to consumption of contaminated water and poor sanitation practices in the area. Block health team visited the affected area. Active search done for new cases. All cases treated. Distribution of ORS packets and chlorine tablets done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Village Singargora GP Chinabri, Block Chhatna due to consumption of contaminated food and water. Block health team visited the affected area. 10 cases admitted for treatment at Chhatna BPHC. Active search done for new cases. All cases treated. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Chakai, GP / SC Pearbera, Block Sonamukhi. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases reported from BPHC Orang TE, due to consumption of contaminated water from tube well. Joint DHS, DSO, Udalgiri alongwith Medical Staff of Orang BPHC visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Medical camp conducted in the affected area. Paramedical team deployed to conduct active survey in the area. Water and stool samples collected and sent to Microbiology Department, GMCH, Guwahati for culture sensitivity found negative for V. cholerae. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from various Pustas in Sonia Vihar due to fecal contamination of drinking water. District RRT and Central team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. 13 sera samples were positive for Anti-HEV Ig M. Health teams surveyed the village to find new jaundice cases. All cases treated symptomatically. Chlorine tablets distributed to the households. Delhi Jal Board officials instructed to chlorinate all water sources. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation. Chlorine tablets and ORS packet distributed among the affected village people. IEC activities done for safe drinking water.

Outbreak reported from Village Balahadlu, PHC Balehole, Block Mudigere. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Out of 18 blood samples collected, 3 samples tested positive for Leptospirosis at Shimoga Medical College. Medical team deployed to affected area to treat cases. Daily house to house survey done for new cases. Prophylactic treatment given to suspected cases. Health education given regarding prevention of Leptospirosis.

Cases reported from Village Sarmal, Sub Centre Sana, Shahapur, PHC Vashind, Block Shingepada Kawadi. District RRT visited the affected area. 16 blood smears found to be positive for P. vivax. Breeding of mosquitoes identified in water bodies in the villages. Active search done for new fever cases. Temporary clinic set up at village to treat fever cases. Indoor fogging done using pyrethrum extract and Larvivorous fish released into tank and ponds. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Central team visited and investigated the report of clustering of cases of Viral Hepatitis C in a few neighboring villages under Tehsil Baheri. District Health authorities reported the occurrence of 41 cases of Hepatitis C since Sept 2010. District Health team as well as the teams from King George Medical College, Lucknow; SGPGI, Lucknow and SRM Medical College, Bareilly had visited the affected areas earlier, treated cases and provided health education regarding prevention of Hepatitis C virus transmission and unsafe injection practices. The unsafe injection practices and lack of awareness among the population was considered the main reason for continued transmission and high prevalence in these areas. Out of 4 sera samples collected by the Central team and tested at NCDC, Delhi, 2 found positive (by ELISA test) for both Hepatitis B and C (Anti-HBc and Anti-HCV antibodies).

Cases with fever and rash reported from Saripakuri Sub Centre, Gram Panchayat Kranti, Block Mal. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Measles vaccination and vitamin A given to all children, and all sick children treated. Active surveillance done in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment and isolation of cases.

Outbreak reported from Daspara colony, Daskin Champapukur, Basirkhat-II Block under North24 Parganas due to contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected and sent to NICED, lab result awaited. Alternate drinking water supply arranged. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from East Kameng due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from village Sultanpur, SC Kakru, PHC Panjkokhera, Block Chaurmastpur. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Water samples collected from the affected area; result awaited. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Khurdhan, PHC Alahar, CHC Radaur, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house survey conducted by the medical and paramedical teams. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. People advised to boil water before using it for drinking purpose and to maintain personal hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Village/PHC Konnur, Taluka Gokak due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool samples collected for lab analysis; result awaited. Field investigation done to determine the cause of outbreak. Alternative safe drinking water made available. Halogen tablets and ORS supplied house to house. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of fever reported from Village Govandiwada, PHC Malvan. Dengue cases previously reported from village Dandi under PHC Malvan. Out of 5 serum samples tested, one found positive for dengue. Rapid fever survey and house to house container survey done. Increased mosquito breeding found in the area. Larvicides used and fogging done in the area. Health education imparted among the affected village people.

Outbreak reported from GP Patkata, SC Natunpara/ Nayabasti, PHC Rangdhamali, Block Sadar. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. All cases are children below 10 years of age. Vitamin A solution and measles vaccination given to all susceptible children in the age-group of 9m. - 5 years.

Cases reported from Village Tehatta GP Kalupur, Laxmipur SD Karimpur-II, Block Natiganga-I. Block medical team regularly visiting affected villages. All cases treated with antibiotics. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures including handling of potentially contaminated articles, proper disposal of carcass, etc.

Cases reported from Village Madanpur, Berhampur, GP Madanpur. Block RRT visited and investigated outbreak reported from the affected area. 3 smears collected and sent to DPH Lab for investigation; lab result awaited. All cases treated with antibiotics. Animal Husbandry Department informed regarding cattle vaccination. IEC activities undertaken regarding handling of potentially contaminated articles, their proper disposal, personal cleanliness etc. Active surveillance is going on.

Outbreak reported from Village Vallur, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Health camps conducted to treat cases. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Kuntala, PHC Kuntla due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Medical camp setup in village. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed to the affected people, ORS depot set up in village. Water samples taken and sent to District lab for analysis, results awaited. Water pipe line repaired and Chlorination of water sources done. Health education imparted on personal hygiene and use of safe drinking water.

Cases reported from Village Na Pamua, Sub Centre Na Pamua, PHC Bengenagorah and BPHC Bengenagorah. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases were from 4-14yrs age group. All cases were given symptomatic treatment and Vitamin -A. Health education given to villagers. Active surveillance being done in the affected as well as near by village.

Outbreak reported from Suffry TE, BPHC Patsaku due to water contamination. District RRT visited the affected area. Stool samples were positive for Cholera culture. Active house to house search done to find new cases in the affected area. Chlorination of water sources done. ORS packets distributed to the affected people. Boiling of water advised for drinking purpose. Health education given regarding sanitation and personal hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Sub Centre Dolagi, PHC Ramchandrapur, and Block Ramanujgarh due to consumption of contaminated water from open well. Medical team visited the affected area, treated cases and organized health awareness camp. Stool samples collected and were negative for hanging drop technique. House to house survey done. Chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from Village Kukaravada, Sub Centre Kukaravada, PHC Kukaravada, Block Vijapur due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak. Food samples were not available for lab analysis. House to house survey conducted to find new cases. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Tavadiya, Sub-Centre Gadha, PHC Bamosana, Block Mahesana due to water contamination. District RRT investigated outbreak. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Block Mahesana, Kasba area due to contaminated water. District RRT Team investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected and sent to District Lab, result awaited. All cases treated. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Madari Falia, Sub-centre Molara, PHC Batakwada, Block Santrampur. All cases treated symptomatically by PHC Medical Officer and advised isolation at home. 5 serum samples collected and sent for lab confirmation, results awaited. Vitamin A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Dupdal, PHC Shindikurbet, Block Gokak, due to consumption of contaminated water. DSO, Epidemiologist and RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 stool samples and 4 water samples were collected out of which one stool sample positive for cholera culture. Active house to house search done to find new cases in the affected area. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Dhawaliwadi, Wadwal, PHC Wavoshi, Block Khalapur due to consumption of contaminated food (Rice, Chana, Chawali, Potato, Brinjal). District RRT visited investigated the outbreak. Food, stool and water samples collected and sent to DPHL, Raigad, result awaited. All cases treated. House to house survey done in the affected area. Health education given regarding food sanitation and personal hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Village / PHC Karanja due to consumption of contaminated food in a marriage. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak. Food, stool and water samples collected and sent to DPHL, Wardha, and result awaited. House to house survey conducted to find new cases. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. Health education given regarding food sanitation and personal hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Village Godyachapada, Sub Centre Poshera, and PHC Morahanda. District RRT Team investigated the outbreak. Medical team deployed in the affected area to treat cases. Active surveillance by house to house visit done to find new fever cases. Out of 25 blood slides, 17 were positive for P. vivax IEC activities undertaken regarding prevention of Malaria by adopting personal protection measures.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Mohalla Nagariya Rewa urban area. Block level medical team visited the affected area and treated cases symptomatically. Vitamin A prophylaxis given to all susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Village Rupidihi, GP / Sub Center Lankahuda, Block Sardar. Block medical team investigated the outbreak. All the cases treated with antibiotics. Animal Husbandry department has been informed for cattle vaccination. IEC activities done regarding handling of potentially contaminated articles, their proper disposal and personal cleanliness.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Ghanupur Kaale. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 6 serum sample collected and sent to Microbiology Department, Govt. Medical College Amritsar; results awaited. All cases were given Symptomatic treatment and Vitamin A. Health education given to villagers Active surveillance being done in the affected as well as near by village.

Cases reported from Shri Muktsar Sahib urban area. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 12 serum samples were collected were tested positive for Ig M Elisa. Active fever surveillance for cases done. Entomological survey revealed Aedes larvae in water storage containers. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control measures in the community and personal protection measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Thirumayam, HSC Thirumayam, PHC Natchandupatti, due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene.

Cases reported from village Thaduthatkondur, Block & PHC Thiruvannainallur due to consumptions of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases treated. Water pipelines were repaired and chlorination of water sources done. House to house survey done to find new cases. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Koothur, HSC Koothur, PHC Adhanur, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. House to house survey done to find new cases. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever with body pain and joint pain reported from Village Kadayanallur, PHC Chockampatti. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 16 serum samples were collected and sent to Trichy Zonal Entomology Team, 6 of them were tested positive for Ig M Elisa. Active fever surveillance for cases done. Entomological survey revealed Aedes larvae in water storage containers. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control measures in the community and personal protection measures.

Outbreak of fever with rash, clinically diagnosed as measles, reported from Pajiyada (Gairsain) village. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Cases of fever and rash reported from Village Bathor (Bhar Toli) PHC Barachawar. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Cases treated symptomatically. Active house to house search done to find cases in the community. Vitamin A solution given to affected children. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Cases reported from Village Heerapur, PHC Chhiriya. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Cases treated symptomatically. Active house to house search done to find cases in the community. Vitamin A solution given to affected children. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village & GP Punisole, Sub Centre Punisole West, Block Onda, due to consumption of contaminated food (beef and vegetables) at a marriage ceremony. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Medical camps were organized in the affected area. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding food safety and hygiene.

Outbreak reported from Jaybangla, Beach line & Daina line, Sub Center Bamandanga Hamlet/TeaGarden, GP Sulkapara, Block Nagrakata, due to consumption of contaminated drinking water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Stool and water sample sent to North Bengal Medical College, results awaited. House to house survey done for new diarrhoea cases. ORS packets and Halozone tablets distributed in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Sahebpara, Sub Centre Bholapara, Block- Rajgani, due to consumption of contaminated water. Most of the cases were clustered around an unprotected well. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 5 water samples collected and sent to Rajgang Water Testing Lab (PHE recognized) results awaited. Chlorination of drinking water supply done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Kuruktopa due to consumption of contaminated water. Block Medical team visited and investigated the affected area. Chlorination of drinking water supply done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Lepchakta, Ochloom, Dargwoon, Sub Centre Santolabari, Block Kalchini. District RRT visited and investigated the outbreak. All cases were given symptomatic treatment and Vitamin A. Health education given to villagers Active surveillance being done in the affected as well as near by village.

Cases of fever reported from Village Lunawada, Block Lunawada. Block Medical team visited and investigated the outbreak. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Daily active surveillance done to find new cases. All cases treated and followed up for complication. Super chlorination of all water sources done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures like proper disposal of waste.

Cases of fever with typical rash reported from Village Chakar, Rijoda, Bhadauta, and Block Kolaras. Diagnosis is based on clinical features only and sera sample not collected for lab test. Control measures undertaken to prevent secondary infection. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases of fever reported from Village Annantpura (Gangepur) CHC Harriya. 5 fever cases admitted at a private hospital for treatment. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Mass fever survey done. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the Community.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from East Kameng due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever occurred at village Khadsupa, PHC Adada, Block Navsari. District RRT visited the affected area. Fever survey done and blood smears of contacts taken. All suspected cases given radical treatment. Larvicide spray done and people advised not to allow stagnation of water in the neighborhood. Health education given regarding early treatment of cases and mosquito control measures.

Outbreak reported from Dalithawada, Atloor PHC due to consumption of contaminated water. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Chlorination of water source done. ORS packet and Furazolidone tablets distributed in the affected area. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village/PHC Devanakonda due to consumption of contaminated water. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever with jaundice reported from Village/Subcenter Kharuapara, BPHC Hagaon due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. All cases treated symptomatically. Water samples tested by HS strip test. Active search done by 2 health workers to find new cases. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Villages Bangfore, Panchim, Nagain, Jyotikuchi, Uttar Deosal, Ghunusa, Koyadol due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected villages along with Medical Officer of Nakhola SHC. 2 stool samples collected and sent to Microbiology Department, Guwahati Medical College; result awaited. Fecal contamination not found in the water samples tested by HS strip test. Active search done in the affected area for new 2 cases. Medical camp organized in the affected area to treat cases. ORS packets and Halogen tablets distributed among the affected village people. Health education is given to the community.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Sekiang, PHC Mengio. Medical team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. All cases are in the age-group of 1 - 7 years. Throat swab samples and serum samples collected and sent to RMRC, Dibrugarh for lab confirmation; result awaited. House to house search done for new cases in the affected area. Health education given regarding isolation of cases.

Cases reported from Villages Jamti Para, Jalke, Block Podi Uproda due to consumption of contaminated well water. Water samples collected from Thodi and sent to PHE Department for analysis. Application of bleaching powder and chlorine tablets done for purification of water. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases with fever and joint pain reported from Village Shivpur, PHC Bugate Alur, Block Hukkeri. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Medical camps organized and door to door fever surveillance done. Entomological survey done and breeding sites destroyed. Anti-larval measures and fogging activities undertaken in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding Aedes mosquito control measures.

Cases with fever and rash reported from Village Dharanatti, PHC Hudali, Block Belgaum. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 6 blood samples collected were positive for IgM ELISA. Measles vaccination given and Vitamin -A solution administered to all susceptible children in and around the affected village. Health education given regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Village Ramanahundi, PHC Kergalli salundi, Block Mysore due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 13 stool and 3 water samples collected, out of which 5 samples were positive for V. cholerae by stool culture. Temporary clinic established and cases treated with fluids and antibiotics. Water pipelines repaired and chlorination of water sources done. House to house survey done to find new cases and ORS packets distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from Village Udigala New Extension, PHC Udigala B, Block Udigala. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Stool sample collected and sent to Mysore Medical College; results awaited. All cases treated. Drinking water sources disinfected and ORS packets distributed among households. Health camps arranged at PHC to treat cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village / PHC / Block Kallahalli due to consumption of contaminated food (uncooked mutton curry) in a festival. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak. All cases treated. Food samples not available for lab test. House to house survey done to find new cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village / PHC Chelora, Block Irivery due to consumption of contaminated food (Dal Chawal). District RRT investigated the outbreak. Food and water samples sent to Regional Public Health lab Kozhikkode for analysis; results awaited. IEC activities undertaken regarding hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Vayakkara Panchayath, PHC/ Block Peringome due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Food materials (rice and atta) sent to Regional Public Health lab Kozhikkode for analysis, results awaited. Active house to house survey by health staff done. IEC done for chlorination of drinking water, personnel hygiene, food hygiene and general cleanliness of the locality.

Outbreak reported from Village Bhaboidi, PHC Nere, Block Bhor due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Water samples collected and sent to State Public Health Laboratory, results awaited. All cases treated. Water pipelines were repaired and chlorination of water sources done. House to house survey done to find new cases and ORS packets distributed. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Durga-Walewadi, PHC Maklgund, Block Ratnagiri due to consumption of contaminated water. Block medical team investigated the outbreak. Water samples collected, results awaited. Chlorination of drinking water supply done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from Mohalla Gons Ward no. 7 Nakodar due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 10 stool samples and 5 water samples collected and sent to Amritsar Medical College, results awaited. Alternative safe drinking water made available till repair of pipeline. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. Cases treated with antibiotics. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Case reported from Village Kikapada due to consumption of contaminated food in a marriage function. Medical officer investigated the outbreak. All cases treated. Health education given regarding food hygienic & sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Bhutavas, PHC Mandoli, Block Jaswantpura. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. House to house visit undertaken for all affected households. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, food hygiene and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Todupura, PHC Hinduan, Block Hindun due to consumption of contaminated food (Ice-cream). Cases treated with antibiotics and antiemetics. Block medical team investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done to find new cases. Samples of ice-cream sent for lab test; result awaited. Health education given regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Dudawas, Gram Panchayat Torda gujram, Kotputli. Block Medical team investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from Village Kappalur, HSC Uchapatti, PHC Checkanurani, Block Thirumangalam due to consumption of contaminated water. Stool samples and water samples collected and sent for lab test; result awaited. Chlorination of water sources done and water pipeline leakages repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever with rash reported from Gangol, Dasoli, Chamoli. Serum samples collected and sent to HIHT Jolly Grant Hospital for lab confirmation; result awaited. Cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Outbreak reported from Khasipura Mohalla near Ratan Talkies, Haridwar. Cases admitted in Mela Hospital, Haridwar. Stool samples sent for lab investigation found positive for Vibrio cholerae. State and District RRT visited the affected area. House to house case search done. Cholera vaccination given to all. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures. Chlorination of water sources done.

Outbreak of vomiting and diarrhoea reported from Village Gorthi kanda, Devprayag. District RRT visited the affected village and treated cases. Some cases treated at village and some others referred for treatment to Devprayag CHC and Srinagar Base Hospital. Stool and food samples collected and sent to District Priority Lab, Pauri. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe food and drinking water, personal hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Daspara, GP/SC Jagadanandapur, Block Katwa-I. District RRT visited the affected area. Symptomatic treatment given. Disinfection of water sources and distribution of ORS packet done. Active survey done to find new cases. IEC activities conducted regarding personal hygiene and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Muslimpara, Nabargarm, Pandabeswar. District RRT visited the affected area. Cases given symptomatic treatment. Stool and water samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Distribution of ORS packet done. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Nowpala Village, Sarat GP, Bagnan-II Block due to consumption of contaminated water. Two medical teams comprising of medical officers and health staff deployed in the village round the clock and two ambulances kept in the village for transportation of patients with diarrhea and dehydration to the hospital. Water and stool samples collected and sent for lab testing. Halozone tablets and bleaching powder distributed in the affected areas. Water pipelines checked for defects/leakages and repaired. IEC done with the help of Panchayat.

Outbreak reported from Village Lepchakha, GP Rajabhatkhawa, SC Santolabari, Block Kalchini. District RRT visited the affected area. 4 cases belonged to the 0-5 yr age-group and 9 cases belonged to 6-10 yrs age-group. Serum samples collected for lab confirmation; result awaited. Active search done for new cases. Susceptible under-five children administered Vitamin-A solution and Measles vaccine. IEC activities undertaken.

Outbreak reported from Village Sahebpara, GP Sukhani, subcentre Bholapara, Block Rajganj due to consumption of contaminated water from an unprotected well. District RRT visited and investigated the affected area. Most of the cases are clustered around the well which is the main source of water in the affected area. 4 out of 5 water samples sent to Rajganj Water testing Lab found contaminated. Active search done for new cases. Disinfection of well done and people advised not to wash clothes or take bath near the well. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Kalirhat Itla Colony Para, Porapara, Senpara, GP Chakdignagar, Block Krishnagar-I, Sadar Sub Division, due to consumption of contaminated food in a common gathering. District RRT and Block level Medical team visited the District Hospital and the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Health education imparted among the affected village people.

Outbreak reported from Ruipukur, GP Amghata, Krishnagar-I Block, Sadar SD. Block level medical team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. All patients treated symptomatically. Health education given regarding personal hygiene and food sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Keshorgoria, PO Bijaydih, SC Dhadkigora due to consumption of contaminated water. Regular visit done by the Block level medical team and necessary drugs, ORS packets and bleaching powder etc distributed among the affected people. IEC activities undertaken.

Cases reported from Village Purana Bandala, Block Kassoana due to consumption of contaminated food (seed of Diesal ka Butta). District RRT visited the area and advised villagers. Stool samples and the suspected poisonous seeds collected and sent to laboratory for testing; result awaited. All cases admitted in Civil Hospital, Zira for treatment. Villagers instructed to destroy all suspected trees from the neighboring villages. ANM instructed to report about any new case from the area.

Cases of fever with rash reported from Maroda Narainbagar Chamoli. Cases treated symptomatically. Vitamin-A supplementation given to all susceptible children in the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding isolation and early treatment of cases.

Cases of fever with rash reported from Ekkar Khurd, Bahadarabad. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. The cases were clinically diagnosed as measles. All cases treated symptomatically. House to house survey done in the affected area. Measles immunization and Vitamin-A solution given to susceptible children. IEC activities undertaken through pamphlet distribution regarding prevention and control of measles outbreak.

Cases of diarrhoea, vomiting and dehydration reported from Nainital town and adjoining area. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Water sources chlorinated. Severe cases treated in District Hospital, Nainital and mild cases treated at the spot by the medical team. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with fever and typical rash reported from PHC Baheri. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Severely ill cases admitted in District Hospital Bareilly. Symptomatic treatment given. Health education given regarding isolation of cases.

Outbreak of diarrhoea reported from East Kameng due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases of fever with altered sensorium reported from Village Arattupuzha Municipal area, PHC Arattupuzha, Block Muthukulame. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Entomological survey done in and around the affected area showed high density breeding of JE vectors like Culex vishnoi and C. gelidus etc. at stagnant water pools in the area. Serum samples collected from 11 fever cases and tested in NIV Alapuzha showed 3 cases positive for JE IgM antibodies. Application of larvicides like abate was done in all the water-logged areas. Fogging activities carried out in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding early treatment of cases and personal protection measures to be adopted by the community like use of ITBN, etc.

Outbreak reported from Jaybangla Line, Beach Line and Daina Line Tea Gardens, GP Bamandanga Hamlet, Sulkaparam, SC, Block Nagrakata due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Bacteria contamination found in the water samples tested at the PHE Lab. 3 stool samples sent to NBMC for culture did not yield any growth of pathogens. Active search done to find new cases. Cases treated and ORS packets distributed in the affected area. Disinfection of water source done. IEC activities undertaken.

Outbreak reported from Village Totopara bazaar, Hospital line, Mongrargaon, PHC/GP Totapara, Block Madarihat due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. 5 water samples collected by the WBCADC- Falakata Project under PHE, found contaminated. 3 stool samples cultured at NBMC did not yield any growth. Treatment of cases done. ORS packets distributed. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak of fever with rash reported from Darjeeling, Kurseong, Sukna, Sittong. Serum samples collected and sent to Kolkata for lab confirmation; result awaited. Symptomatic treatment and Vitamin – A oil supplement given to the susceptible children.

Cases reported from Village Kantatoir (Adibashipara), GP Sukhdevpur, Block Gangarampur due to consumption of contaminated water of pond. Block health team visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. ORS packets distributed among the affected village people. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Village Athnoor, PHC Nyalkal due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area. Active survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from PHC Devanakonda due to consumption of contaminated water. Block medical team investigated the outbreak. House to house search done to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Nandikotkur, Pagidyala Mandal due to consumption of contaminated water. Medical camp conducted in the affected area. Paramedical team deployed to conduct active survey in the area. Stool samples collected and sent to District lab, results awaited. PHC medical officers monitoring the situation. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health awareness sessions conducted.

Outbreak reported from Villages Lakkavaram, Bollapalii and PHC Martur due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Samples were not available for lab analysis. All age groups were affected with the complaints of vomiting, pain abdomen and loose motion. All cases treated at medical camps organized in the areas. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, food safety, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases with symptoms of vomiting, loose motion and mild dehydration reported from villages Garo Dokan, Khagarpur, North Salmara Part 1, SC North Salmara/ Khagarpur, BPHC Srijangram due to consumption of contaminated food at a birthday party. All cases were admitted at Abhayapuri FRU for treatment. Medical team with paramedical staff from Srijangram and Bongaigaon BPHC visited the affected area. Active search done for new cases in the affected area. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe food and drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Outbreak of fever reported from villages Katribari, Garlabari, Runikhata, of Banduguri and Bamungaon SC, Sidli BPHC. The cases who died were positive for P. falciparum by Rapid Test. Mass fever survey done and blood samples collected for lab test; result awaited. Fogging and indoor residual spray done and bed nets distributed. Malaria camp organized in the affected area. House to house surveillance done by the health workers.

Outbreak of vomiting and loose motion reported from Village Bhepara, PHC Dhemaji after consumption of contaminated food (Mahaprasad). District RRT visited Dhemaji Civil Hospital and the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool sample collected and sent to Microbiology deptt. AMCH, Dibrugarh; result awaited. Cases treated at Dhemaji Civil Hospital. Active case search is done. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Khemati Line, Mottuck tea estate, adjacent to Lahowal PHC, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected and sent to Microbiology department, AMCH; result awaited. Active search done in the affected area by health workers. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among the affected villagers. Health education given to the community regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases with vomiting and diarrhea reported from Village Sensowa, SC Chetiagon, MPHC Dakhinhengra, BPHC K.B. Ali due to consumption of contaminated food (Prasad) at a common gathering. District RRT with BPHC medical team investigated outbreak in the affected area. One patient hospitalized in KK Civil Hospital for treatment. 4 stool samples examined at District Priority Lab, Golaght, showed growth of E. coli. Fecal contamination found in water samples tested by HS strip test. Active case search done by 2 health workers. Water sources disinfected.

Cases reported from Gelapukhuri TE, Garden line no. 13, Hapjan BPHC due to consumption of contaminated water. Medical team from Hapjan BPHC visited and investigated in the affected area. Stool and water samples collected and sent to Microbiology Department, AMCH, Dibrugarh; result awaited. Active search done in the affected area for new cases. 2 patients admitted in Tinsukia Civil Hospital. All drinking water sources chlorinated. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Sakalana, PHC Panchada, SC Dhota, and Block Vadgam due to consumption of contaminated well water. Block health team investigated the outbreak. Serum samples tested positive for IgM Hepatitis A at Civil Hospital, Ahmedabad. House to house survey conducted for new cases. Chlorination of drinking water supply done in the village. Health education given regarding hygiene, sanitation and safe drinking water.

Cases reported from Village Sonarada, PHC Vadodra, Taluka Gandhinagar due to consumption of contaminated water. Block Health team visited and investigated outbreak. Out of 101 water samples collected for testing residual chlorine, 96 samples tested positive. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Village Amritpura (Nagari, Somjipura), Sub Centre Saiyat, PHC Chetersumba, Block Thasra due to consumption of contaminated water. Block Medical team and DSO investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected and sent to NHL Medical College, Ahmedabad, result awaited. ORS packets distributed to the affected people. Active search done to find new cases. Disinfection of drinking water sources done. Health education imparted to the community regarding and hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from SC Kanera, PHC Vasana, Margy, and Block Kheda due to consumption of contaminated water caused by leakage in water pipeline. Block Health Officer visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Water samples sent for lab testing; result awaited. Active house to house survey conducted to find new cases. All cases treated. ORS packets and chlorine tablets distributed in the locality. Leakage in water pipeline repaired. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village/ PHC Vasai, Block Vijapur due to consumption of contaminated food. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak. All cases treated. Medical camp was conducted in affected village and house to house survey done for new cases. All cases treated. IEC activities undertaken regarding food hygiene and sanitation.

Outbreak reported from Morbi City due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Serum samples collected and sent to Rajkot Medical College, 6 of them were positive for Hepatitis A IgM ELISA. Water samples were not fit for drinking purposes. All cases treated symptomatically. House to house survey done to find new cases Chlorine tablets distributed to the households. Water supply officials instructed to chlorinate all water sources. Medical care provided to all affected. Health education given regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Cases reported from Village Pardi, Sub Centre Allu, Block Bardoli, PHC Vankaner, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated outbreak. Water samples and Stool samples colleted and sent to District lab, result awaited. House to house survey done to find new cases. Drinking water line repaired & blockage of drains removed. Halogen tablet and ORS distributed and people advised regarding sanitation and hygienic practices.

Stool samples were negative for cholera culture and water samples on analysis found unfit for drinking purpose (showed presence of Escherichia coli). Outbreak reported from Village Sanganahalli, PHC Janawada, Block Bidar due to consumption of contaminated water (water pipe leakage). DSO, THO, MO team investigated the outbreak. Stool samples collected and sent to Bidar Institute of Medical Sciences (BIMS), results awaited. Health clinic setup to treat cases. Safe drinking water supplied through water tankers till repair of broken water pipeline. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among affected people. Health education given to the villagers regarding sanitation and hygiene.

Cases of diarrhoea reported from Village / Sub Centre Gadgi, PHC Chillargi, Block Bidar. Block Medical Team investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected and sent to BIMS, results awaited. Health clinic setup to treat cases. Safe drinking water supplied through water tankers till repair of broken water pipeline. Halogen tablets and ORS packets distributed among affected people. Health education given to the villagers regarding sanitation and hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Ballakere, Sub Centre Anivala, PHC Mallappanahalli, Block Hosdurga. Health education given regarding personal protection measures.

ORS packets distributed in the affected area. Health education given to community to maintain hygiene and to drink safe drinking water.

Outbreak reported from Village Galipura, PHC Paduvalippe, Block Holenarsipura due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Stool and water samples collected, results awaited. Chlorination of water sources done. Cases reported from Village Madahalli, PHC Beerihundi, Block Mysore due to consumption of contaminated water (Water valve point leakage). Chlorination of water and repair of water pipeline done. Alternate safe drinking water supplied till repair of broken water pipeline. Health education given regarding hygiene, sanitation and safe drinking water.

Outbreak reported from Village Sayne, PHC Chikhalohai, Block Malegaon due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Health education given regarding sanitation and hygienic practices.

Outbreak reported from Village Kasupur, PHC Rupewali due to consumption of contaminated water (water pipe damage). District RRT investigated the outbreak. IEC activities undertaken regarding safe drinking water, hygienic practices and sanitation measures.

Cases reported from Sant Nagar, PHC Verka due to consumption of contaminated water. Cases reported from Village/ PHC Arudiapuram, Block Virdhunagar. District RRT visited and investigated outbreak in the affected area. Samples of stool water sent for culture. Health education given regarding drinking safe water and sanitation measures.

Outbreak reported from Village Umayalarkadu, Adanjur, PHC Nagathi, Senthalai, Block Thanjavur. Polio immunization (OPV) given to all over 6 weeks of age who have not been completely immunized or whose immune status is not known.

One case of acute flaccid paralysis (8 months old) belonged to Village Bhatgaon, P.O Bhagwaan, Tehri being treated at Base Hospital Srinagar, Pauri Garhwal. Cases reported from Charui Beldari under Noorsari PHC. 6 male and 6 female children were affected and all were previously unimmunized. District RRT team visited the affected areas and investigated the outbreak. Vitamin A solution administered to all affected children. Health education given.

Outbreak reported from Village Gangpur of Lalpur Block Gaurela due to consumption of contaminated water. Block RRT visited the affected areas and organized local health camp. Chlorination of water sources done. Active surveillance and IEC undertaken.

Outbreak reported from Somai Jhopdi, Puja Maidan, Bagbeda, Jamshedpur under Golmuri cum Jugsalai PHC due to consumption of contaminated water. Medical camp held for the treatment of patients. Cases reported from Bunumlata Village, Khuntpani Block, West Singhbhum; with fever, headache, chills, rigors and loose motion. All cases treated symptomatically. Block team carried out house to house survey for fever cases and breeding sites of mosquitoes. Out of 100 samples collected 4 were positive for P. falciparum malaria. Spraying operation done. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control and personal protection measures.

Cases reported from Zachaldara, Wadipora, Goriakar. A team of Doctors and Paramedics sent to the affected area to provide necessary treatment. 6 Blood Samples & 2 Water Samples sent to the District Public Health Laboratory Kupwara and State Public Health Lab Barzulla for investigation. Results awaited. Health education was imparted to the general public of the affected area.

Outbreak reported from Village Navada, Bhatola, Tigaon and Ballabhgarh under Faridabad urban area. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. 50 of the 146 samples collected and sent to NCDC Delhi, tested positive by IgM capture ELISA. Anti larval activities and IEC done.

Outbreak reported from Village Vachesar, Varsada, PHC Vejpur, Block Savli. District team EMO and DMO visited and investigated the outbreak. 5 out of 6 Serum samples sent to Microbiology department at Medical College Vadodara tested positive for Chikungunya. Active house to house surveillance and ant larval activities done. Fogging in 38 houses and IEC activities done.

Cases reported from Village Kamtana, PHC Kamtana, Block Bidar due to consumption of contaminated water due to pipe line leakages. One stool and 9 water samples collected. Stool sample tested negative for cholera. Repairs of the pipeline leakages done. Halogen Tabs distributed. IEC regarding hygiene and drinking boiled water done.

Cases reported from Villages Achooranam & Pozhuthana, PHC: Pozhuthana, CHC Thariode, Block Kalpetta. RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases are aged 6 months to 8 years. Five serum samples sent to for lab diagnosis through NPSP lab network tested positive for Rubella. Active search for cases done. Health education classes done at schools where the cases were reported from. Medical camps / special immunization programmes.

Outbreak reported from Village Bhopawar, Block Sardarpur. Block medical team investigated the outbreak. 87 blood smear positive for P. falciparum. Active surveillance done by house to house visit. Mass fever survey and entomological surveillance done. DDT spray done and IEC activities undertaken regarding personal protection measures for prevention of malaria.

Outbreak reported from Village Saikheda, Block Khaknar. District RRT investigated outbreak. Serum samples positive for Chikungunya by IgM ELISA. Mass fever survey done by house to house visit. DDT sprayed and source reduction measures undertaken in and around the affected village. IEC activities undertaken regarding prevention of Malaria by adopting personal protective measures.

Cases with symptoms of diarrhoea and vomiting reported from village Jerapura, Block Nalecha due to consumption of contaminated food. Block Health Officer with medical team visited the affected area, treated cases and investigated the outbreak. Food samples not available for lab analysis. Health education given regarding food sanitation.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from Village Kavdiya, Block Maheswar. District RRT visited the affected areas and investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done for new fever cases. IEC activities undertaken regarding mosquito control measures in the community and personal protection measures

Outbreak reported from Osmanabad, Pohner, Warwanti due to consumption of contaminated water. Six water samples sent to DPHL. Result Awaited. All surrounding area of reservoir was cleaned and a chamber is being constructed to safe guard the pipe. Temporary hospital ward is being established in Anganwadi and a medical officer is posted along with paramedical staff. Village is divided into four parts and one MPW along with ASHA worker is deputed for rapid surveillance.

Outbreak reported from Hedwali. PHC - Nagothane, Taluka – Roha. Patients complained of nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain due to consumption of contaminated water. DHO, DSO, District Epidemiologist, visited and investigated the outbreak. Water samples and stool samples collected and sent for laboratory investigations and results are awaited. Isolation Ward created at local temple to check patients. OPD basis treatment given to 89 patients. Alternate supply of drinking water through tanker arranged and house to house survey being done for ADD cases. All patients are stable. Health education given to villagers by THO and MO regarding boiling of drinking water and use of soap to wash hands before cooking and preparing food and after defecation.

Outbreak reported from Auraiya, Ayana, Dhanupurbandha ka purwa. Village is surrounded by pond. District RRT visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak and conducted entomological survey. 39 BS Collected, 13 positive (11 Malaria Pv and 2 Pf Malaria). Presumptive malaria treatment given to suspected cases. IEC activities along with mosquito control measures undertaken (spray 50% DDT).

Cases reported from Village Chhoumolly SC Onda Gram, GP Onda-I, Block Onda. Block RRT team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. All cases have been treated. IEC done and health education imparted regarding proper sanitation and food habit. Vitamin A given to all those affected.

Cases of fever with joint pain reported from Village Hozaghata, S.C. Bankrishnapur, G.P.Gangadharpur. Four samples tested positive for Chikunguniya. IEC activities done regarding personal hygiene maintenance. Mosquito control measures undertaken.

Outbreak reported from Ward No. 26, Belur Road, Liluah with symptoms of suspected chikungunya. District RRT team visited affected area and investigated the outbreak. 15 blood samples collected and sent for serological test. Result awaited. IEC done. Medicine distributed and larvicidal oil sprayed in the affected area by health workers of the municipality.

Outbreak reported from Village & SC Paramanandapur GP Brindabanchak Block Kolaghat due to consumption of contaminated food (Kachaury). Medical team visited the affected area. Health check up IEC done.

Cases of loose motion with vomiting reported from SD Kalyani, Block Chakdaha, Municipality Chakdaha, Colony Radhakrishna, Ward No. 19. Chakdaha Municipality Medical Team visited the area and primary treatment given to patients. Two stool samples were collected and sent to NICED on 18.10.11. Both samples were found to be Vibrio Cholera 01 Ogawa +ve, Health education done.

Outbreak reported from Village Nagabandha of BPHC Laharighat.. Ten water samples tested by H2S strip found negative for fecal contamination. Two stool samples collected and sent to Microbiology Department GMCH on 05.09.11 and result showed growth of Shigella flexneri (Sensitive to Ofloxacin. Piperacilinn, Cefixime). Halogen tablets and bleaching powder distributed for disinfection of water. Free ambulance service arranged at Laharighat BPHC for 24 Hrs. IEC organized at Pachim Nagabandha primary school. Health education given to the community.

Cases reported from village Dudu colony, SC: Laharijan of BPHC: Bokajan. Medical team from Bokajan BPHC visited the affected area. Two of the four deaths reported were under 5 years of age group. Water samples collected and tested by H2S strip and result showed no fecal contamination. Halogen tablets distributed to the community for the chlorination of the drinking water. ORS distributed to the patients. Health education given to the community.

Outbreak reported from Village Pargala, Block Basna due to consumption of contaminated water. Situation is under control.

Outbreak reported from Ward no.7, 8, 3, and 15 of CHC Arang. All the patients started passing loose stools and vomiting after consuming contaminated water from a tank in the ward. Cases of diarrhea reported from Village Seghada, Block Pohari, due to consumption of contaminated water. District RRT with Block medical team visited the affected area and investigated the outbreak. Cases of loose motion reported from Village Jhariakocha, S.C. Gopalpur, GP Gopalpur, Block Hirbandh due to consumption of contaminated water. Outbreak of fever reported from Village Wave, PHC Revadanda, Block Alibaug.
