Cases of fever with rash reported from villages Tapra, Majrahi and Bisaria, HSC Birnagar, PHC Bhargama, District Araria. District and Block RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 samples were collected and sent to PMCH Patna; all are positive for measles

Cases of fever with rash reported from village Krishna nagar, Dedaur Panchayat, PHC Sadar, District Nawada. Affected age group is 11 months to 13 years. Block RRT investigated the outbreak.5 blood samples collected and sent to PMCH, Patna, all 5 were positive for Measles IgM ELISA. Symptomatic treatment given to cases. Vitamin A supplementation given.

Cases of fever with rash reported from village & SC Khutali, PHC Dudhani, Block Silvassa. Age group of the affected cases range from 1-10 years. Majority of the cases have received 1 dose of Measles vaccine. 6 serum samples collected & sent to DPHL Silvassa, out of which 3 were positive for Measles IgM ELISA. No more cases have been reported.

Cases of acute onset diarrhea and vomiting reported from S. S .Hospital, Petlad, Block Petlad, District Anand. District and Block RRT investigated the outbreak.7 water samples collected and sent to state public health lab, all were fit for consumption. Control measures undertaken.

Cases of fever with rash reported from villages Billpudi1 & 2,, PHC Sidumbar, Block Dharampur and district Valsad. District RRT investigated the outbreak.5 serum samples sent for testing to BJMC Ahmedabad, all were positive for Measles IgM ELISA. , Treatment provided to cases. House to house survey done.

Cases of fever with vomiting reported from Village Muchoradaldali, SC Badore, Block Boarijore, District Godda. RRT investigated the outbreak. Out of 59 slides examined, 11 were positive for Falciparum malaria. Health education given regarding use of mosquito nets. Symptomatic treatment given to al the cases.

Cases of fever with rash reported from Village Sarvil, SC Maudi, Block Barajamda, District West Singhbum. District & Block Health Team investigated the outbreak. Majority of the cases were unimmunized. 5 serum samples were collected & sent to Institute of Serology, Kolkata; out of which 4 were positive for Measles IgM ELISA. House to house survey done. Health camp was organized. All cases treated symptomatically. IEC activities done. Isolation of the cases done. Vitamin A solution was given to the affected children.
Cases reported from village village Lokur, PHC/CHC U Betageri, Taluka / district Dharwad.RRT investigated the outbreak.2 serum samples collected and sent to KIMS Hubli, result awaited.

Cases reported from village Padesur, PHC/CHC Alagwadi, Taluka Navalgund district Dharwad. DistrictRRT investigated the outbreak. 2 serum samples collected and sent to KIMS Hubli,both the samples tested positive for Chikungunya IgM ELISA.

Outbreak reported from SC Sansarpur, Block Bahoriband, District Katni. All the cases started vomiting after consuming food. All of them are students of primary school Sansarpur. All cases treated at District hospital Katni.

Case of fever reported fromVillage Bhavsinghpura, PHC Jawar, Block/ District Khandwa. Rapid fever survey done. I sample tested positive for Dengue by IgM ELISA. District Malaria team visited the affected area & treated all cases. Fever survey done. Aedes larva was destroyed by temphos. Indoor survey of pyrethrum done. Health education given on personal hygiene and sanitation.
Cases reported from Village Gondi guradia, Block Budhni, District Sehore. all the cases had consumed ratanjot seeds after which they started vomiting. All cases treated. Human samples?

Cases of fever reported from Village Ghogargaon, SC Belipimpalgaon, PHC Newasa B, Block Newasa, District Ahmednagar. There is increase in mosquito density. Entomological survey was done in the affected area. HI- 4.25, BI-5.61, CI-2.60. Out of 37 serum samples tested at sentinel site Ahmednagar, 10 are positive for Dengue IgM. Rapid fever survey done. fogging done. Health education given.

3 Cases of fever reported from Village Maregaon, SC Chambhara, PHC Amirza, Block & District Gadchiroli. 01 case of fever reported from Village Regadi SC Madeamgaon, PHC Regadi, Block Chamorsi District Gadchiroli.District RRT investigated the outbreak. 72 blood smears were tested, out of which 3 were positive for PF and 1 for PV. Fever survey done. Medical Camp was organized in the area.

Cases of fever reported from Village, SC & PHC Wadner Bhairav, Block Chandwad District Nashik.District RRT investigated the outbreak. Entomological survey was done in the affected area & revealed HI-8.47, CI_5.34. 3 serum samples were tested at DPL Nashik; result awaited. 5 blood slides were tested for malarial parasite, all were negative. Fever survey done. Health education about environmental sanitation given. Indoor spray with 2% pyrethrum done.

Cases of fever reported from Village Ambad, SC & PHC Nanashi, Village & PHC Kochargaon Block Dindori, District Nashik. RRT investigated the outbreak. 12serum samples sent to DPL Nashik, all are negative for Dengue. 49 blood slides were tested for malarial parasite, all were negative. Fever survey done. Health education about environmental sanitation given. Indoor spray with 2% pyrethrum done.

Cases reported from Govt. Middle & Primary school, village Jatoli, HC Nurpur Bedi, District Rupnagar. RRT investigated the outbreak. .All affected children are students of the school belonging to the age group 7-14 years.15 blood samples were collected & sent to District Lab Rupnagar, out of which 10 were positive and 1 was equivocal for Mumps IgM ELISA. . Parents asked to keep the infected children in isolation. Health education given to school staff, students and parents regarding the disease. House to house survey done.

Cases reported from Central University Bandarasindiri, SC Bandarasindri, PHC Harmada, Block Kishangarh, District Ajmer.RRT investigated the outbreak. All 10 blood samples tested positive for Hepatitis A by IgM ELISA. 8 water samples sent for testing at DPL Ajmer, result awaited.2 food samples taken. Inspection of mess and canteen kitchen done. Unhygienic surroundings and lack of supply of safe water observed.IEC done regarding food and water hygiene. Chlorination of water samples done.
A Case of 7year old female child reported from village & SC Umrain, CHC Wair, Block Bhusawar, District Bharatpur. No more new cases detected. Immunization status not known.

Cases of jaundice reported from Juni Mandi, Old Jodhpur city, District Jodhpur. The outbreak is suspected to be due to pipeline leakage. All age groups affected. Out of 5 blood samples tested at Virology Lab, SMS Jaipur 2 were positive for Hepatitis A & 3 were positive for Hepatitis E. 10 water samples were collected & sent to lab for testing for fecal contamination, all were positive for fecal contamination. Door to door survey done. IEC activities done regarding early treatment of cases.

Cases of fever with joint pains reported from village & HSC Veeranam, PHC Sathanur Dam, Block Thandrampattu, District Tiruvannamalai.RRT investigated the outbreak.10 Blood smears sent to PHC all were negative. 3 serum samples were collected and sent to Zonal Entomological Team Lab Vellore, out of which 1 was positive for Dengue and Chikungunya, 1 was positive for dengue and scrub typhus. Minor ailments treated. Anti- larval and anti adult measures undertaken.

Cases of fever reported from Andhiyur, Athani, Panchampalayam, Kollapalayam & pallapalayam, District Erode. Out of 7 blood samples tested at DPHL, Erode, 4 were positive for Chikungunya on IgM ELISA. Fever survey done. source reduction done. Anti-larval activities conducted. Health education given.

Cases of fever with joint pains reported from village & HSC Thondamandurai, PHC Arumbavar, Block Veppanathattai, District Perambalur. Out of 6 serum samples tested for Dengue at DPHL Perambalur, 1 tested positive for Dengue on IgM ELISA. . Source reduction done. Antilarval and anti adult activity done.IEC done.

Cases of fever with nausea and arthalgia reported from village & HSC Naranamangalam, PHC Padalur, Block Alathur, District Perambalur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Out of 11 serum samples 6 tested positive for Typhoid by widal. Pipe leakage rectified chlorination of water and disinfection done.

Cases of fever reported from village S Vellakulam, HSC T. Velangudi, PHC Veeracholan, Block Narikudi, District Virudhnagar.District RRT investigated the outbreak. 4 serum samples were collected & sent to ZET Virudhnagar, out of which 1 was positive for Dengue IgM ELISA & 1 was positive on Widal.Fever survey done. Source reduction and antilarval activity done.

Cases of diarrhea reported from PHCs Katra, Sakra, Aurai and Musahari, District Muzzafarpur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 5 samples sent to SKMCH, Muzzafarpur, result awaited... 4 positive for cholera on culture

Cases of fever with rash reported from village Inderanagar, SC Pipali, PHC Khareda, Block Morbi, District Rajkot majority of the cases are between 0-5years of age (6). .4 out of 5 serum samples sent to Medical College Rajkot tested positive for Measles IgM ELISA. House to house survey done. Treatment provided to cases.IEC activity done.

Outbreak reported from Village Kodiyathur, Block PHC Cheruvady (Kunamangalam), District Kozhikode. Source of infection is suspected to be contaminated water. District Surveillance team investigated the outbreak. 15 samples were collected & sent to Regional Public Health Lab, Kozhikode, out of which 7 tested positive for HAV IgM ELISA. House to house survey done. Mass chlorination done. Medical camp was organized. Health education given.

Cases of fever with joint pains reported from Village Umarkhaal & V Block Ichhawar, District Sehore. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Out of 23 blood samples tested at District Malaria Office Bhopal, 7 were positive for chikungunya. Larva survey done. 35 blood slides tested for malaria, all were negative for malaria. Pyrethrum & Temephos spray done. One 6 year old boy died due to the condition?

Cases of fever reported from Villages Chapan Khurd , Jivapur Mahodia & Bavra, Block Ashta, District Sehore. RRT visited the affected area along with malaria department. 52 Blood slides were tested for malarial parasite, all were negative for Dengue.

An outbreak of fever with joint pain reported from several bocks namely Lakhandur, Lakhani, Sakoli, Tumsar & Mohadi of District Bhandara. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Active search of fever cases done. Medical camps were organized in the community. All cases treated symptomatically.07 deaths occurred in < 45year age group. All 594 blood smears examined were negative for malaria. Out of 44 serum samples collected and tested at IGMC Nagpur 02 samples were found to be positive for dengue. Entomological survey revealed high indices (>7)for HI, BI, CI. Fogging and source reduction were done in the community. Health education regarding personal protection given.

Cases reported from Village Bordeorigaon, SC Borderi, PHC Dhalpur, Distt Lakhimpur. The affected persons had history of consumption of rice and pork on 23/11/2014 after which they developed vomiting, pain abdomen and loose stools. All the cases were above 10 years of age. A total of 05 stool samples were collected and sent for culture and sensitivity; no pathogenic organisms were isolated. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Health education is given to the community.

Cases reported from Village Annaram, SC PHC/ Mandal Chervu Annaram, Mandal Kattangur, Distt Nalgonda. A total of 174 students consumed midday meal, after which 34 of them developed symptoms of Nausea, Vomiting, headache and stomach pain. Medical team visited the area. Health education given to the food handlers, school staff and students regarding food hygiene.

Cases reported from Village / SC Aitipamula, PHC/ Mandal Kattangur, Distt Nalgonda. A total of 131 students consumed midday meal, after which 32 of them developed symptoms of Nausea, Vomiting, headache and stomach pain. Medical team visited the area. Health education given to the food handlers, school staff and students regarding food hygiene.

Cases reported from Village/ UHC/Taluka Kalol. .District Gnadhi Nagar.District & Block RRT investigated the outbreak. . 2 blood samples taken and sent for viral hepatitis serology Both the samples found to be positive for HAV. IEC activity was done regarding hand washing and boiling of water along with regular chlorination of drinking water.

Cases reported from Village/SC Sonarda, PHC Vadodara, District Gandhinagar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 02 stool samples sent to Civil Hospital Gandhi Nagar ,both samples were found to be negative for any pathogen. 01 water sample sent to GJTI (Gujtrat Jalseva Training Institute ); result is awaited. House to house survey done. Health education given to the people in the community.

Cases reported from Guhai Colony Himmatnagar, Taluka Himmatnagar, Distt Sabarkantha. Cases presented with pain in abdomen and vomiting. 14 serum and 02 water samples sent to Civil Hospital Himatnagar, out of 14 serum samples 07 found to be positive for HEV. Both the water samples were found to be potable. House to house survey done. Chlorine tablets were distributed and health education given.

Cases reported from Village Pilol, SC Bakrol, PHC Jantral, Taluka Kalol, Distt Panchmahal. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the cases had history of consumption of food in a Vastu Pujan ceremony. No food/stool or water samples were sent for testing. House to house survey done to identify all the cases. Health education given to the people in the community.

Cases reported from Village Kaddiya, SC Keska, Block Tundi, Distt Dhanbad. District RRT investigated the outbreak. One male child aged 10 months & one female child aged 02yrs died due to the condition.05 blood sample taken and sent to Institute of Serology, Kolkata.All 05 samples found to be positive for Measles IgM ELISA. Immunization activities were strengthened in the area. Health education given to the people regarding isolation of cases.

Cases reported from Village Jatajhopdi, Ranidih Koketola and Bazar Tola, CHC Golmuri cum Jugsalai, Distt East Singhbhum. District RRT visited the area. 03 females aged 3years, 45years ,50years & 01 male aged 15 years died because of the condition. 03 stool samples were colleted & sent to MGMCH,Jamshedpur; stool culture was negative for all the samples. All the wells in the area were chlorinated. Health education was given to the people and advised to maintain hygiene and sanitary measures.

Cases reported from Village Simrakitta, SC Bhandaridih, PHC / Block Mahagama, Distt Godda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. A total of 05 serum samples were collected and sent to Institute of Serology, Kolkata for Ig M; out of which 04 were found to be positive for Measles IgM ELISA. All the cases were treated symptomatically. Immunization activities were strengthened in the area.Health awareness programme were conducted in the village.

Cases reported from Village Neema, SC Barasimra, PHC / Block Boarijore, Distt Godda.District RRT investigated the outbreak. Majority of cases were males and <01 year old.oOut f 05 serum samples collected and sent to Institute of Serology, Kolkata for IgM; 03 samples found to be positive for Measles IgM ELISA. the cases were treated symptomatically. Immunization activities were strengthened in the area. Health awareness programme was conducted in the village.

Cases reported from Village /SC Kharpose, Block Manjhgaon, District West Singhbhum. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey was done. Majority of cases belonged to 11-20 year age group. A total of 05 serum samples were collected and sent to Institute of Serology, Kolkatta for IgM all of them were found to be negative for Measles & Rubella. Health awareness programme were conducted in the village.

Cases reported from Village Sukki, SC Balasa, PHC Tadkalas, TQ Purna.District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done and mosquito larvae found during investigation. 10 samples collected , results awaited.

Cases reported from Village Mhaisal, SC Mhaisal, PHC Mhaisal, Block Miraj. House to house survey done. Isolation ward established and contact treatment given. Disinfection of water tank along with repair of damaged pipeline done. 28 stool samples sent to Govt. Medical College, Miraj. Report awaited.

Cases reported from Village Khadiyapura, SC Durkooda& Village Manpura, SC Nichli Bahrai, Block Pahadgarh District Morena. Door door rapid fever survey done. 39 blood smears examined, out of which 16 found positive for Falciparum Malaria. Focal spraying done and health education given

Cases of fever & rash reported from Village Katra- Sunehra, PHC Raksheha, Block Devendranagar District Panna . Chief Medical & Health Officer along with District Immunisation Officer visited the area and provided treatment. 05 serum samples sent to GMC Bhopal, all were negative for Measles and Rubella.Vit-A given to all suspected. Sick children referred to District Hospital, Panna. Measures to follow-up new cases instituted.

Cases reported from Village GajiKhedi, Block Ichhawar District Sehore. Supervisor, ANM, MPW visited the area.30 blood smears were examined, all were found to be negative for malaria. Health education given.

Cases reported from Indira Colony, Distt Patiala. It was observed that the drinking water was contaminated by sewage water due to leakages in water supply line. 3 Blood samples were sent to District Public Health Laboratory out which 01 was positive for HAV & 01 was positive for HEV. 5water samples were for analysis District Public Health Laboratory, report awaited. House to house survey was done in the area. Medical camp organized in the area. IEC activities done. Water supply department requested to repair pipeline.
Cases reported from Village Bulade Wala, Block Goniana, Distt Bhatinda. All the cases were treated symptomatically. Isolation of cases was done. Health education given to all the children and adults.

Cases reported from Bidesh Tilla, Champamura GP Under old Agartala Block, Distt West Tripura. All the affected persons consumed meal at a religious ceremony. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Patients admitted in IGM Hospital. All the patients have been discharged.Health camp organized.

Cases reported from Village Kaslana, SC Dewal, Block Naugaon, Distt Uttarkashi. Of all the cases only 2 had prior history of vaccination. A total of 05 serum samples were collected and sent to HIHT Jolly Grant for measles confirmation; result awaited. Vitamin A given to the cases. Health education given regarding isolation of cases.

Cases reported from Village Pathar Madhaipur, Block Old Malda, Distt Malda. Majority of cases were among migratory population. A total of 29 samples were tested by RDK out of which 12 were positive for P Falciparum and 1 for P Vivax. 21 blood smears were examined out of which 18 tested positive for P Falciparum. Health education given to people to increase awareness.

Cases reported from Village / SC Patharghata, Block Tehatta I, Distt Nadia. All the cases had history of consumption of leftover food from a marriage ceremony, after which they developed abdominal pain and vomiting followed by loose motion. One stool and one food sample collected. Stool sample sent to NICED Beleghata, Kolkata and has been found negative. Food sample sent to the Food analyst, West Bengal State Public Health Laboratory. Result awaited. Health education given.

Cases reported from Khardaha Municipality, Ward No 17 and 18 Goswamipara, Distt North 24 Parganas. The cases presented with Low grade fever, upper abdominal pain, anorexia, vomiting and yellow sclera. A total of 05 serum and 06 water samples were taken and sent to School of Tropical Medicine Kolkata; 05 serum samples were reactive for HAV IgM .In the water samples on MPN count and culture no bacterial growth detected. Authorities were instructed to clean water supply line and take repair measures. Until then people were advised to drink boiled water and provided with halogen tablets for domestic chlorination. Health education given.

Cases of cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis reported from Village Kubaliyapara, Ward no 16, UHC Champak Vora, Block East Zone, Distt Rajkot. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All children were in the age group of 0-5 years. A total of 05 serum samples and 03 throat swab samples were collected and sent to NIV Pune and BJ Medical College Ahmedabad respectively. All tested positive for Measles. Vaccination started in the area. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Dabhoi, CHC Dabhoi, Distt Vadodara. District RRT investigated the outbreak .A damage in drinking water pipeline was detected which lead to contamination of water. 04 stool samples and 02 water samples were sent to Public Health Laboratory Vadodara. All 04 stool samples tested negative for any pathogen and 01 water sample was found potable. House to house survey done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Serampur Municipality, Ward No -07, Mukherjee Para, Musalman Para and Gopinath Saha St, Distt Hooghly. District RRT investigated the outbreak. A total of 15 blood samples collected and sent to DH Hooghly, out of which 07 tested positive for Dengue by IgM ELISA. Health education given.

Cases reported from GP Arjunpur, Tofapur, Bhabanipur, Ramrampur, Sankhopara, Distt Murshidabad. Fever survey was done in the area. A total of 40 serum samples taken and sent to MMCH Murshidabad; 16 samples tested positive for Dengue by IgM ELISA. Health education given to people to increase awareness.

Cases reported from Village Bodamolladinne, SC Isukanuthapalli, PHC CTM,Mandal Madanapalle District Chittoor. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Out of 08 water samples collected and sent to Regional Public Health Lab, Tirupati, only 02 samples were found to be potable. All 03 rectal swabs sent to SVIMS Tirupati tested negative for any pathogen. 02 females aged 16& 45 years died due to the condition. A medical camp was organized. Water tanks were cleaned and water chlorinated. Health education given on personal hygiene and environmental hygiene.

Cases reported from Village Kotbarpally, SC Sangakalam, PHC Gingurthy, District Ranga Reddy. District RRT investigated the outbreak All the cases had history of consumption of midday meal. Health education given on drinking water and personal hygiene. No human samples sent for testing.

Cases reported from village Sisona, ward no. 04 Block Jokihat, District Araria. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Cases presented with fever with rash, Coryza and conjunctivitis. Majority of cases were in the 04 to 10 years age group. All cases treated symptomatically and isolation done. Health education given.

Cases of fever with rash reported from Indiranagar, UHC Sec 24, District Gandhinagar.District. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Majority of cases belonged to 2-5 years of age group. No history of prior measles vaccination. A total of 05 serum samples collected and sent to BJMC Ahmedabad out of which 04 were positive for Measles. Health education given in the area.

Cases reported from Harijan Vas Faliyu of Village Pilol, SC Bakrol, Block Kalol, District Panchmahal. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the cases had history of consumption of food in a religious ceremony. House to house survey done. All patients referred to CHC. Health education given in the area. No human samples sent for testing.

Cases reported from Village Amarpur, SC/ PHC / Block / Meherma, District Godda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. A total of 05 serum samples were collected and sent to Institute of serology, Kolkata for IgM, Result awaited. Majority of cases were less than 06 years of age. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education regarding isolation of cases and immunization given.

Cases reported from Village M G Thimmapura, PHC Negalur, Taluk Haveri, District Haveri. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Consumption of contaminated water could be the probable cause of outbreak. 02 stool samples collected and sent to referral lab Shimoga, tested negative for cholera culture.02 water sample tested and found to be non potable. Chlorination of water source done. Alternate water supply provided & chlorine tablets distributed. Health education given.

Cases of fever with joint pains reported from Village Megoor, PHC Holealur, Taluk Ron, and District Gadag. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 03 samples collected and sent to sentinel lab NVBDCP Gadag. Out of which 01 was found to be positive for chikungunya by IgM ELISA. Fever surveys done in the area.Source reduction measures were taken. Health education given

Cases reported from Kambumala Tea Estate of Village/PHC Perya, Block Manathavady, District Wayanad. District RRT investigated the outbreak.All the cases had history of participation in a social ceremony. 01 stool sample collected and sent to medical college Kozhikode tested negative for cholera culture. 01 water sample sent to Kerala water authority found to be non potable Medical camp organized in the area and all the cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Aroda, CHC Mundi, Block Punasa, District Khandwa. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Aedes larva found in water along with adult aedes mosquito in houses. 35 blood smears were examined, and all were negative for malaria.04 Serum samples were collected and sent to MGM Medical college Indore out of which 03 samples found to be positive for chikungunya by IgM ELISA.Temephos applied to water bodies and indoor spraying with pyrethrum done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Mojwadi Dhana, CHC/Block Khalwa, District Khandwa. District RRT investigated the outbreak.27 blood smears were examined, all were found positive for malaria. 26 Tested positive for P Falciparum and 01 for P Vivax. Focal spraying with DDT done. Health education given regarding source reduction & personal protection.

Cases reported from Village Tiladia, Block Nasrullaganj, District Sehore. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Consumption of water from a contaminated well could be the probable cause of the outbreak. One water sample from the well taken and sent to PHE department, found to be non potable. Chlorination of the well done, alternate water supply arranged. Health education given on safe drinking water practices.

Cases reported from Village Hayderganj, Block Shyampur, District Sehore. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Aedes larva found in some houses. 50 Blood smears examined, all slides were negative for malaria. 05 serum samples collected and sent to DMO Bhopal, out of which 03 were found to be positive for Chikungunya. Health education given to the people in the affected area.

Cases of fever with rash reported from a hostel in Navapur Urban, District Nandurbar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All the cases were from same hostel. A total of 09 serums sent to NIV Pune and all were to be found positive for Measles. All the cases were isolated. Outbreak response immunization started. All cases were provided with Vitamin A. Health education given in the area.

Cases of loose stools with blood reported from Government Sevashrama High School, GP Panchada, Block Laxmipur, District Koraput. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The probable source of infection was consumption of water from a nearby open dug well. All the cases were treated symptomatically. Well water was tested by H2S test which was non potable and OT test showed low chlorination. Disinfection of well and the tanks done. No human samples were sent.

Cases reported from 27 Colonies of Sodala area of Jaipur City. District RRT investigated the outbreak. People of all ages are affected. All the cases occurred within a period of 2-3 days and presented with yellow discoloration skin, sclera and urine. A total of 63 blood samples were tested at SMS Hospital out of which 48 were positive for Hepatitis E and 01 for Hepatitis A. 27 water samples were tested at Jaipuria Hospital and all were found to be potable. House to house surveillance done in the area. Medical camps organized in the affected areas. Health education regarding safe drinking water practices was given.

Cases reported from Ginnani area of Bikaner city, District Bikaner. All the cases had history of developing diarrhea; vomiting and abdominal pain after drinking contaminated water. A total of 02 stool samples and 01 vomitus sample taken and sent to SPMC Deptt Bikaner and E coli were isolated from stool while vomitus contained no pathogenic organism. 10 water samples were also collected and sent to PHED lab Bikaner, all the samples were found to be potable. Pipeline leakages were rectified and water chlorinated. House to house survey done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Mankarattupalayam, HSC Emapalli, PHC Erayamangalam, Block Tiruchengode, District Nammakkal. All the cases developed vomiting after having dinner in a marriage. A total of 05 blood samples sent to DPHL Nammakkal for Blood culture, no growth of any pathogen. Medical camp organized. Health education given

Cases reported from Village Achankulam, HSC Pisindi, PHC Mallankinar, Block Kariyapatty, District Virudhunagar. District RRT investigated the outbreak. It was observed that there was water logging in the area which was the cause of mosquito breeding in the area. A total of 06 serum samples sent to Virudhunagar ZET, out of which 01 sample tested positive for Dengue and 01 for Chikungunya. House to house fever surveillance done. Source reduction activity done. Health education given regarding mosquito breeding and personal protection.

Cases reported from Village / HSC Thiruvellai Voyal, PHC Kattur, Block Minjul, District Thiruvallur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Consumption of contaminated water could be the probable cause of this outbreak. 05 water and 07 blood samples sent to DPHL Tiruvallu, out of which 02 water samples were found non potable and 02 blood samples positive with WIDAL. Medical team deputed in the area. House to house survey done. Chlorination done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village S Malaiyanur, HSC Pugaipatty, PHC Eraiyur, Block Ulundurpet, District Villupuram- Kallakuruchi. District RRT investigated the outbreak A total of 27 serum samples tested at PHC Eraiyur with WIDAL, out of which 23 tested positive. Repair work done in pipelines. Chlorination done. Health education given.

An increase in number of cases was observed in the month of December 2017 (40 cases, December 17 and 10 cases in Jan 2018). Eschar manifestation were not reportedly observed among the cases. Environmental studies were conducted and rodent infestations were observed in the surveyed area. All cases were treated and cases were followed up at their houses. All the 81 samples were tested by Rapid Test kits (SD Bioline, Tsutsugamushi kit). Health awareness campaign regarding scrub typhus was organized at Community Hall, Phullen.

Cluster of 3 cases of Viral encephalitis reported from Block Perambra, PHC- Chengaroth. The unusual event started with death of a 26 yr male, clinically diagnosed as viral encephalitis at Medical College Hospital. Two weeks later 2 members of the same family reported with similar symptoms, rapidly progressed and died while on treatment, at a private tertiary care hospital. On subsequent days 6 more persons succumbed to similar symptoms, including a staff nurse of the taluk hospital, involved in treatment of the second case. All the affected cases were found to have close contact with a confirmed case/death. District RRT team along with the central team of NCDC investigated the outbreak. House to house active case search and contact tracing was done. Serum and CSF samples were sent to MCVR Manipal & NIV Pune. Nipah Virus Encephalitis PCR test was confirmed positive for initial three cases and therafter many more. Isolation points identified and infection control protocol strengthened. Adequate quantity of PPE and other logistics ensured in the district. Burial protocols issued. Home quarantine for the contacts and hospitalized observation for all symptomatic implemented. Medical camps conducted in the area for disease awareness and reducing panic.

An 85yr old female resident of Shastri Nagar (ward 23) of Jaipur city was confirmed as Zika positive on 21st September 2018. The case presented with fever, joint pain, redness of eye and body ache. She was hospitalized on 11th September with neurological disorder and had a previous history of seizure disorder for last one and half year after cerebrovascular accident. Her blood and urine samples were confirmed as Zika by NIV, Pune & SMS Medical College, Jaipur. On 24th September, 2018, Secretary (Health) deputed a high level team of Senior level Officers – Advisor, NVBDCP, Director, NCDC and experts from NVBDCP, ICMR NIV Pune (National reference laboratory), AIIMS, New Delhi and NIMR to review Zika situation, surveillance and response plans including preparedness and availability of testing kits and insecticides for taking appropriate public health measures. Subsequently, IDSP in Rajasthan has been undertaking active surveillance on daily basis for suspected cases of Zika Virus Disease in affected area of Jaipur. A total of 6 confirmed cases of Zika are reported till 24th September 2018.

Central level, State level and District level RRT were constituted to investigate the outbreak. House to house fever survey was initiated around the affected areas. Fogging, larval control and personal protective measures were initiated in the area. A total of 486 blood samples were collected and tested at AIIMS Bhopal, of which 130 were found positive by RT-PCR. A 18 year old male tested positive for Zika and died of coinfection with Dengue and JE, similarly another women of 23 years tested positive and died of multiorgan failure.

Cases had history of consumption of food consisting of fish, chicken and liquor after which they developed Diarrhea and admitted at NRI General Hospital. 3 stool samples collected at NRI Hospital and tested Negative. 2 water samples collected and sent to regional lab for biological & chemical analysis and found negative. One stool sample sent to Guntur Medical college, result awaited. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given. Protection from heat wave also advised and a big tent with jumbo air coolers also installed at shelter for these workers. A 26 year old female and 70 year male died of illness.

Cases reported from Village Kotta Vedurupalli, PHC R.V.Nagar, Mandal Chintapalli. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 6 members of the same family collected mushrooms from the surrounding area and consumed it. No samples were collected. Villagers are educated to take only eatable mushrooms and to take fresh hot food. Para Medical Staff concerned have been instructed to continue door to door surveillance for one week. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Pothangi, PHC Dumbriguda. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 1 water samples have been collected and send to the Regional Public Health Laboratory for analysis, result awaited. Water sources Chlorinated by the Panchayat. Health education given to take fresh, hot food and clean water and also to maintain environmental sanitation in the village. Para Medical Staff concerned have been instructed to continue door to door surveillance for 3 days. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Village Seajuli Tiniali, MPHC Seajuli, BPHC Boginodi. All cases were from two families and had history of consuming mushrooms harvested from vicinity. After consumption they developed abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea. All of them admitted in Civil hospital and treated. 3 stool samples collected for culture and sensitivity test, Result awaited. RRT investigated the outbreak. Active Surveillance is going on by the health workers in the affected area. Awareness camp organized in the affected area.

Cases reported from Various villages of District Tinsukia. All had history of consuming mushrooms harvested from jungle. After consumption they developed abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea. All of them admitted in Tinsukia Civil hospital and further referred to Assam medical college and treated. RRT investigated the outbreak. Active Surveillance is going on by the health workers in the affected area. Awareness camp organized in the affected area

Cases reported from AT Vashudev Patti and Chakia Mohammadpur, HSC Saraiya, PHC/Block Saraiya. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Symptoms of red eyes, maculo popular eruption on body reported by cases. Majority of them belonged to low socio-economic condition, poor sanitary conditions found. MOICs & RRT Medical Team, visited affected area for investigating and taking control measures. All affected person and others sensitized about their personal hygiene and cleanliness. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village ToyBigha, HSC Kajifattuchak, PHC Barbigha, Block Barbigha. All patients are having fever with maculo popular rash. All patients given treatment & medicine under supervision of MOIC & Medical team. All affected were between 2 to 25 years of age. RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house survey done. Cases reported from Village Tille Gowdana Doddi & Rasi Boli Thanda, PHC/CHC Sathegala, Taluk Kollegal. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Index case had history of travel to Gundal, Duganikote Tq, Dharmapuri District, Tamilnadu one week prior to development of symptoms. He developed fever and joint pain and within one week other people of village developed same symptoms. 5 blood samples tested negative for Dengue and Chikungunya, 15 blood smears tested negative for Malaria.

Cases reported from Village Aurundi, PHC/CHC Nyamathi CHC, Taluk Honnali. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases attended a ceremony. 05-water sample tested by H2S method at DSU and 02 found unfit. 01 stool sample collected and found negative for any enteropathogen. All cases treated. Cases reported from Village Koradkera, PHC/CHC Chalgera, Taluk Kustagi. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Leakages in water pipeline have been observed causing mixing of drinking water with sewage. Leakages have been repaired and chlorination done. Alternate water supply provided. 3 stool samples tested negative for Salmonella, Cholera and Shigella and 4 water samples sent to DPHL Lab found potable. Health education given.

Und er Surveillance Cases reported from Village Alkola, PHC/CHC Seegihatti, Taluk Shimoga. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Well-Water contamination was suspected for the Outbreak. Government well is a common source of drinking water, through which water is supplied to households through pipelines. Well water contamination has been suspected as the cause of outbreak. 36 blood samples and 4 water samples were collected and sent to DSU lab. 20 blood samples tested positive for Hepatitis E by Ig M ELISA and 3 out of 4 water samples tested unfit for drinking. Well has been chlorinated and all cases treated at health facility.

Cases reported from Village Manjapra, PHC/Block Angamaly. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All cases had history of consumption of food in a marriage ceremony. Possible source of infection was pasta salad as per case history. All cases had abdominal pain, vomiting and loose stools. 2 water samples collected and sent to RPH lab Ernakulam, result awaited.

Cases reported from Village Div12, HSC Thevally, PHC Thrikkadavoor, Block Kollam Corporation. All cases had history of consumption of food in a marriage ceremony. Food handlers were examined and none of them had health card. Kitchen premises were unhygienic and water used for cooking was also unchlorinated. Cases had abdominal pain, loose motions and vomiting. 2 water samples taken and sent to PH lab Kollam for culture and found satisfactory. All cases treated. Water chlorinated. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village/HSC Chendayad, PHC Kunnothuparamba, Block Panoor. District RRT investigated the outbreak. 2 Blood samples collected and tested at RPH Lab Kannur and found positive for Hepatitis A. Water sample from the wells used for cooking purpose in the function collected and sent to quality analysis. Cases had history of consuming food in a marriage ceremony. Mass super chlorination done. Fever survey done.

Cases reported from Village Ponganad, HSC Nil, PHC/Block Kilimanoor. District RRT investigated the outbreak. It was observed that around 50 children were being given swimming training in village pond by some private agency. All 03 affected had history of going to this pond. They developed fever and body ache. 3 blood samples taken and all found positive for Leptospirosis by Ig M ELISA. Panchayat was alerted and people asked not to take a dip in the pond. Pond cleaning started.

Cases reported from Village Jaiaw, Shillong. Four males and four females were affected with age group ranging from 20 to 60 years. The common symptoms were multiple episodes of diarrhea and vomiting, nausea, chills and abdominal pain. Two stool samples collected and sent to ICMR Dibrugarh, result awaited. No food sample was available for collection. Investigated by RRT. The cases were admitted to a private hospital in Shillong and provided symptomatic treatment and at present are responding well to the treatment.

Cases reported from Boys Government Residential Hostel Nimbhora under Amravati Muncipal Corporation. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Pipe-lines and Valve leakages, irregular chlorination, Junk food and bad dietary habits, all these factors caused Viral Hepatitis A. 1 water sample collected and sent to DPHL Amravati. Result – Awaited. Active case search done. Super- chlorination of main water source (Bore-well) done. Alternate water supply started. All cases treated symptomatically.

Cases reported from Village/CHC/Block Segaon. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Leakeages were observed in water pipelines supplying water to households. 4 stool samples were collected and sent to department of microbiology MGM medical college Indore, result is awaited. 5 water samples collected by PHE department, result are awaited. District RRT investigated the outbreak. House to house health survey done, chlorine tablets and ORS packets distributed. Medical camp organized and all cases treated symptomatically. Health education given among community.

Cases reported from Village Shanpur, PO/SC Sikachhida, CHC/Block Chudapali. District RRT investigated the outbreak. ORS distributed. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Bariapali, GP Seriguma, SC Deulabadi, CHC/Block K. Singpur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. All patients were labourers and staying at a camp near Bariapali village. All had history of consumption of poisonous wild Mushroom collected from the nearby Jungle. They developed hematemesis and unconsciousness. All patients were immediately shifted to DHH Rayagada for treatment. Affected cases are treated at DHH Rayagada HW (M) &HW (F) is in search of new cases. MO I/C CHC K. Singpur is advised to keep the village under surveillance for 2 weeks from the date of reporting of last case. MHU K.Singpur deployed for 7 days to the village for case management & MAT. IEC activity regarding safe water and food items. All cases treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Urban Pratapgarh. SMS Medical College Jaipur for Confirmation of Measles & Rubella by ELISA, result awaited. DRRT Visited Affected Area. House to House surveillance is ongoing. All cases treated under isolation.

Cases reported from 2 RKM, Kundal Village Gharsana. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The affected case had history of consumption of raw milk from a cow he owned. RRT visited the area. Patient was treated and discharged asymptomatic. House to house survey done. Health education given.

A 23 year old male residing at Vadakkekara, Paravur a student of Al Akbar College Thodupuzha, presented symptoms of fever with altered sensorium was referred to a private hospital at Eranakulam on 30th May 2019. Throat swab, CSF, blood and urine were collected and sent to NIV Pune; the samples were found positive for Nipah Virus (Real-time RT-PCR, nested RT-PCR and for anti-Nipah human IgM and IgG antibodies by ELISA assay). Presently the case is stable. Central team and State/District RRT investigated the outbreak. Control room was set up at State Headquarter (Trivandrum) and District Headquarter (Ernakulum). 330 contacts were traced and 13 suspected cases samples were found negative for Nipah. 141 bats were captured and samples were collected (rectal and throat swabs) were tested. Out of these one bat sample was found positive for Nipah viral RNA. Standard NIPAH outbreak guidelines were implemented in the hospital and community settings. Health education given.

Insecticide spraying over animals and households, deltaforce liquid for washing animals, Malathion+lime powder dusting in 109 houses with domestic animals by Animal husbandry department.

Cases reported from Village Kulathupuzha, HSC Neduvannoorkadavu, PHC/CHC/Block Kulathupuzha. District RRT investigated the outbreak. During a medical camp conducted by a private lab at Kerala Livestock Department Board, routine blood examination was done and some cases were positive for Brucella. A total of 70 samples were collected and sent to State Public Health Lab for testing Brucellosis, of these 02 were positive for Brucella abortus by tube agglutination , 08 were positive for Brucella by IgG ELISA and 05 were weakly positive. In the previous week 02 pregnant cows underwent abortion in the farm, Brucella ELISA tests done for both cases and found negative. Fever survey conducted. All cases were treated symptomatically. Health education given.

Cases reported from Shastrinagar, PHC SDH Vaijapur, Block Vaijapur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The deceased was a 21 year old male. Scattering of cases was seen in areas where mosquito density raised, HI 12.44%, BI- 12.44% Ades density 3.2%. A total of 53 blood samples collected, 07 serum samples collected and sent to GMC Aurangabad, result awaited. All cases were treated symptomatically. House to house survey conducted. Fogging done. Source reduction activities undertaken. Health education given.

Cases reported from Ramchandra Nagar No. 30, UHC Kajuwadi, Thane Municipal Corp. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The deceased was a 24 year old male who tested positive for Dengue by IgM. A total of 05 blood samples were collected and tested at Jupiter Lab Thane; all were negative. Container surveillance and fever surveillance done. Fogging done. Health education given.

Cases reported from Village Mariguda, SC Mariguda, CHC/Block Padmapur. District RRT investigated the outbreak. The rectal swab samples were found positive for E. coli and all 11 water samples were found potable. All cases were treated symptomatically. Active case search done. Cases reported from VPO Harraipur, Block Goniana. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Clustering of cases noted.
